title: Virtual Assistant — Lead Generation & Content Operations (Part-Time, 15 hrs/week)
description:
ABOUT FUTUREGIG:

Hiring at most companies is a mess. FutureGig exists to fix that.

We're a lean recruiting consulting company helping small and mid-size businesses build hiring processes that actually work — without replacing the humans that make those processes good.

This isn't a big agency. It's not a corporate machine. It's a scrappy, fast-moving team that believes AI should make recruiters better, not replace them. Human First. AI Powered. That's not a tagline — it's how we operate every day.

You'd be joining early. That means your fingerprints are on everything.



THE ROLE:

We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Virtual Assistant to run our lead generation and content operations system. This is a part-time role — 15 hours per week — with the expectation of expanding to full-time as the business grows.

You will work inside Notion, LinkedIn, and Buffer. You will follow documented SOPs for every task. You will not need to improvise or make judgment calls — your job is to execute the system precisely and flag anything that needs the founder's attention.

This role is ideal for someone who is organized, takes pride in accurate work, communicates proactively, and wants to grow with a company long term.



YOUR WEEKLY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Monday — Prospect Research (3 hours)



Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify 20 new qualified prospects per week

Filter by: HR Director, Head of People, VP of HR, TA Manager titles; 50–500 employee companies; non-advertising industries

Add all prospects to the Notion Prospect Tracker database with complete information

Flag the batch as ready for founder review before outreach begins



Tuesday & Wednesday — Outreach Execution (5 hours)



Execute the 5-touch LinkedIn outreach sequence on all active prospects

Follow the exact outreach templates provided — personalize one specific detail per message

Update prospect status, touch number, last action date, and next action date in Notion after every touch

Never send more than 20 connection requests per day

Flag any responses immediately for the founder — do not reply on behalf of FutureGig



Thursday — Content Drafting & Scheduling (4 hours)



Draft two LinkedIn posts per week for the FutureGig company page using the content brief framework provided

Write a strong hook (first line), full post body, and select 5 hashtags from the approved set

Submit drafts in Notion with status set to "Needs Review"

Once approved by founder, schedule posts in Buffer at assigned times

Maintain at least 2 weeks of approved content in the queue at all times



Friday — Weekly Report (2 hours)



Complete the weekly report template in Notion covering: prospects added, outreach touches executed, responses received, content status, and any blockers

Flag any prospect responses or situations needing the founder's attention

Send founder a brief message that the report is ready for review

Plan the following week's task list



TOOLS YOU WILL USE:



Notion (task tracking, SOPs, content calendar, prospect database)

LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator (prospect research and outreach)

Buffer (content scheduling)

 or WhatsApp (weekly check-ins with founder)



Full training and SOPs will be provided for every tool and task. You do not need prior experience with all of these tools — but you must be a fast learner and comfortable with new software.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Required:

- Excellent written English — you will be drafting LinkedIn content and personalized outreach messages

- Strong attention to detail — accurate data entry in Notion is critical

- Reliable internet connection and consistent availability during agreed hours

- Proactive communicator — you flag issues before they become problems

- Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

- Experience with LinkedIn preferred but not required



Preferred:



- Prior experience as a VA for a consulting, recruiting, or B2B company

- Familiarity with CRM or database tools (Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, etc.)

- Experience drafting professional content or copywriting

- Understanding of LinkedIn outreach and lead generation



WHAT THIS IS NOT:



- This is not a sales role — you will never pitch or close clients

- This is not a creative director role — content topics and frameworks are provided

- This is not a customer service role — all client communication goes through the founder



COMPENSATION & HOURS:



$350/month USD

15 hours per week

Part-time with strong potential to expand to full-time as the business grows

Flexible schedule within the Monday–Friday week — tasks are structured by day, not by hour



HOW TO APPLY:

To be considered, please send the following:



A 2–3 paragraph introduction telling us who you are, what kind of work you do best, and why this role interests you

One example of written work in English — a LinkedIn post,
, short article, or any professional writing sample

Your answer to this question: "An HR Director at a 200-person tech company responds to your LinkedIn message and says they're interested in learning more. What do you do next?"



Applications without all three items will not be reviewed. The answer to question 3 is the most important part of your application.

title: AI-Assisted Graphic Designer
description:
AI-Assisted Graphic Designer Needed for Caribbean Creative Agency

(Part-time, project-based, or long-term depending on skill fit)



VEYA / Capture Cut Color is a Caribbean-based video production and marketing company working with hotels, tourism brands, local businesses, real estate companies, events, NGOs, and premium service businesses.

We create video, photo, social content, campaign graphics, landing page visuals, ads, carousels, pitch decks, and branded visual systems.





We are looking for a graphic designer who can work inside modern AI-assisted design workflows while still producing clean, intentional, professional visual work.



This is not a random AI art role. We are looking for someone who understands design, brand consistency, typography, image references, and how to avoid the cheap AI-generated look.



Outcome of This Role:

Your job is to help us produce high-quality client graphics faster by using a mix of Canva, Figma, Claude, ChatGPT, image generation tools, and structured prompt/JSON workflows.





Success in this role means:

You can take a style reference and match the visual direction closely.

You can use AI image tools without producing obvious AI-looking results.

You can work from existing JSON prompts and adjust them carefully.

You can create multiple consistent variations from one visual direction.

You can prepare client-ready graphics in the correct sizes.

You can organize prompts, references, exports, and source files clearly.

You can follow brand guidelines and not randomly change the style.

You can explain what you changed and why.



You will help create:

Instagram carousel graphics

Event graphics

Visual concepts based on reference images

Use existing JSON prompts.

Adjust prompts for different brands or products.

Match a reference image style.

Generate consistent variations.

Keep a prompt log.

Save working prompts for future reuse.

Identify which prompt changes improved or worsened the result.

Convert a visual direction into a reusable prompt structure.

Test multiple versions without losing the original direction.



Experience with JSON-style image prompts is a major plus.



The goal is not to copy blindly. The goal is to understand the style system and create something that feels like it belongs in the same visual world.



Required Skills:



You must have experience with:

Canva or Figma

Strong typography basics

Good layout and spacing

Visual reference matching

Exporting for Instagram,
, web, and ads

Following brand guidelines

Creating clean, organized folders

Naming files properly

Taking feedback and improving designs



AI Tool Experience

Please list any tools you have used, such as:

ChatGPT - Image2

Claude

Canva AI

Other AI image or design tools



You do not need to know every tool. But you must understand how to produce controlled, consistent visual results, not just random AI images.



Important: What We Do Not Want

We are not looking for:



Random AI images with no design direction.

Obvious AI-looking results.

Poor typography.

Generic Canva templates.

Designs that ignore the reference style.

Someone who changes the whole direction without being asked.

Someone who only knows how to type one sentence into an image generator.

Someone who cannot organize source files and prompt versions.



Nice-to-Have Skills

These are helpful but not required:



Photoshop

Illustrator

Figma

Jitter

Basic motion graphics

Presentation design

Ad creative design

Experience creating design systems

Experience with product mockups

Experience creating layered PSD or Figma files

Experience working inside JSON prompt systems



Tools We Use:

Canva

Figma

Photoshop

Google Drive

Google Docs

Google Sheets

ClickUp

Claude

ChatGPT



Example Projects You May Work On

A luxury Caribbean villa needs carousel graphics and ad visuals.

A ginger tea company needs product lifestyle graphics.

A carnival/event brand needs promotional graphics.

A hotel needs social media templates.

A real estate client needs clean listing graphics.

A tourism campaign needs polished visual concepts.

A construction/home brand needs high-end Instagram graphics.

A pitch deck needs cleaner visuals and mockups.

A static ad needs to be recreated as a more polished layout.

A client gives us an inspiration image and asks us to match the design style.



What Success Looks Like After 30 Days

By the end of the first 30 days:

You have completed several test graphics using our workflow.

You understand how we organize references, prompts, exports, and source files.

You have created reusable Canva or Figma templates.

You have helped improve at least one existing JSON/image generation workflow.

You can create 3–5 strong visual options from one direction.

You can identify and fix common AI-looking issues.

You are able to produce graphics with less back-and-forth.



Hours and Pay

Start project-based or part-time.

This can grow into ongoing weekly work if the quality is strong.



Please include your desired hourly rate, monthly rate, or project rate in your application.



Application Instructions

To apply, please send a message with the subject line:

VEYA AI GRAPHICS - [Your Name]

In your application, include:

A short introduction.

Your graphic design experience.

Your AI image/design tool experience.

A link to your portfolio.

Examples of AI-assisted graphics you have created, if available.

Your experience with Canva, Figma, Photoshop, or Illustrator.

Your experience with structured prompts or JSON prompts, if any.

Your desired hourly, monthly, or project rate.

Your availability in Philippine time.

Your computer setup and internet speed.



Required Test Task

Please complete the test task below:



Applications without the test task will not be considered.

Please share:

Bonus Test

Take one of the graphics you created and show:

This helps us see your taste, judgment, and ability to refine.

Lead Generation & Qualification: Identify and qualify potential leads through systematic inbound and outbound outreach efforts to generate new business opportunities.

Value Presentation: Present and communicate the value of our marketing products and services in a clear, compelling manner tailored specifically to the prospect's pain points and business goals.

Sales Execution & Closing: Follow up on high-intent leads and proposals in a timely manner; strategically address complex objections, and guide prospects through the final stages of the sales process to secure signed contracts.

Pipeline Management: Build and maintain a healthy, active sales pipeline; manage advanced opportunities through the CRM from discovery to won.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with the marketing and onboarding teams to ensure a seamless handoff, setting accurate client expectations, and guaranteeing a positive initial customer experience.

Quota Achievement: Consistently meet or exceed individual and team sales quotas and key performance indicators (KPIs) established by management.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Purpose 

The Offshore Short-Form Video Editor turns raw footage from Paul Peterson and Alarmed Media LLC into high-retention, platform-ready short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, LinkedIn, and other assigned channels. This role requires technical editing skill, strong pacing, clean captions, emotional judgment, and the ability to make educational mental health content feel engaging, credible, and shareable without becoming gimmicky or misleading.



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting 

- Complete 12–18 finished short-form videos per week during the initial phase, scaling toward 15–25 videos per week as assigned based on complexity and support. 

- Deliver first drafts within 24–48 hours after receiving usable raw footage and clear instructions. 

- Complete final revisions within 24 hours when feedback is clear and all source assets are available. 

- Maintain 90%+ approval within two revision rounds by following brand standards and instructions accurately. 

- Maintain at least 98?curacy for captions, spelling, grammar, platform formatting, export settings, and file names. 

- Produce correct platform versions, including 9:16 vertical exports and any assigned 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, thumbnail, or caption file formats. 

- Identify editing patterns, hooks, first-frame choices, caption styles, or pacing choices that may improve retention and report them weekly. 

- Use only approved, licensed, royalty-free, owned, or properly authorized music, images, video clips, graphics, fonts, templates, and AI-generated assets. 

- Maintain zero unauthorized use of client footage, PHI, testimonial material, OAC-restricted assets, copyrighted content, or unapproved third-party materials. 

- Organize raw files, project files, final exports, caption files, and archive folders according to approved naming and storage standards. 

- Upon achieving these key performance indicators, the supervisor will meet with the contractor to review progress and collaborate on establishing new performance goals that reflect continued growth, quality, and accountability. 



Core Competencies 

- Demonstrate strong short-form video editing skill, including pacing, captions, cuts, pattern interrupts, sound, first-frame quality, and retention editing. 

- Demonstrate the ability to preserve Paul’s message while improving clarity, energy, and watchability. 

- Demonstrate good taste and restraint with mental health content so edits feel credible, emotional, and professional rather than flashy or disrespectful. 

- Demonstrate strong file organization, version control, attention to detail, and ability to meet recurring deadlines. 

- Demonstrate appropriate escalation when footage, content, claims, privacy, or source materials create risk. 



Core Responsibilities 

– These duties may vary depending on project assignments and Company needs. 

- Edit raw footage into short-form videos, typically between 10 and 75 seconds unless otherwise assigned. 

- Create platform-ready versions for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, LinkedIn, and other assigned channels. 

- Add accurate burned-in captions, clean text overlays, strong first frames, and visual emphasis that supports the message. 

- Remove dead space, unnecessary pauses, filler, repeated words, weak openings, and confusing sections while preserving accuracy. 

- Use zooms, cuts, b-roll, graphics, music, and pattern interrupts only when they strengthen the message and match the brand. 

- Repurpose long-form videos, interviews, podcasts, or presentations into short clips when assigned. 

- Recommend stronger openings, clip selections, titles, or visual structures when raw footage contains a better hook later in the recording. 

- Export and label all final files clearly by date, topic, platform, version, and approval status. 

- Maintain editing templates, caption presets, brand elements, file structures, and project files for reuse. 

- Communicate quickly when raw footage, audio, lighting, file access, instructions, or source materials are incomplete or unusable. 

- Perform other duties as assigned commensurate with the position duties. 

- Adhere to all Alarmed Media LLC policies, confidentiality rules, contractor agreements, and platform-access standards. 



Required Qualifications 

- 2+ years of short-form video editing experience preferred, especially with TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts,
 Reels, or personal-brand content. 

- Experience editing educational, podcast, founder-led, coaching, health, mental health, or mission-driven content preferred. 

- Proficiency with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or comparable editing software required. 

- Strong English captioning, spelling, grammar, and on-screen text judgment required. 

- Ability to export clean vertical 9:16 video and adapt videos for multiple platform requirements. 

- Reliable computer, internet access, and secure file-management practices required. 



IMPORTANT: Please attach a link to your most updated resume and portfolio in your message.

The Offshore Social Media Coordinator / Community Manager is responsible for scheduling, publishing, monitoring, organizing, and reporting on approved Alarmed Media LLC content across assigned social platforms. This is not a clinical role and does not provide therapy, diagnosis, crisis counseling, or individualized treatment advice. 



Key Performance Indicators and Reporting 

- Publish or schedule at least 95% of approved posts on time according to the assigned content calendar.

- Maintain zero unauthorized posts, wrong-version posts, public PHI disclosures, public treatment-relationship confirmations, clinical advice responses, or unapproved crisis responses. 

- Escalate urgent, clinical, privacy, legal, complaint, crisis, OAC-related, or reputation-risk items immediately according to the escalation process. 

- Complete at least one social workflow, analytics, response-template, tracking, or scheduling-process improvement quarterly.

Core Competencies 

- Demonstrate strong social media scheduling, platform management, caption adaptation, community monitoring, and analytics tracking skill. 

- Demonstrate professional judgment, emotional maturity, and clear boundaries when reviewing comments and messages from vulnerable or distressed individuals. 

- Demonstrate strong organization, attention to detail, file/link accuracy, and deadline follow-through. 

- Demonstrate the ability to identify audience language, recurring questions, and content opportunities from comments and platform performance. 

- Demonstrate strict confidentiality and appropriate escalation of sensitive information. 



Core Responsibilities

- Schedule and publish approved content across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn, and other assigned platforms. 

- Confirm that the correct video version, caption, title, thumbnail, hashtags, links, and platform settings are used before posting. 

- Adapt captions and titles for each platform while preserving accuracy, tone, and approved messaging. 

- Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, shares, tags, and audience engagement according to assigned schedules. 

- Organize audience questions, objections, pain points, and story ideas by theme for future content planning. 

- Identify comments that may become strong reply videos, FAQs, carousels, podcast topics, or long-form video topics. 

- Maintain and update social media performance trackers, dashboards, content logs, and platform links. 

- Escalate crisis comments, clinical questions, legal complaints, privacy concerns, OAC-related questions, spam, threats, harassment, or reputation issues according to approved rules. 

- Use only approved response templates and do not provide clinical advice, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, crisis counseling, or individualized guidance.

- Perform other duties as assigned commensurate with the position duties. 

- Adhere to all Alarmed Media LLC policies, confidentiality rules, contractor agreements, and platform-access standards. 



Required Qualifications 

- 1–3+ years of experience managing or supporting social media accounts, content calendars, posting schedules, community management, or analytics preferred. 

- Experience with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube,
, LinkedIn, and/or scheduling tools preferred. 

- Strong written English and ability to adapt captions, titles, comments, and reporting summaries professionally. 

- Experience working with personal brands, educational content, healthcare, mental health, coaching, nonprofits, or mission-driven organizations preferred.

title: GoHighLevel VA — Client Onboarding & Website Setup (Part-Time, Room to Grow)
description:
GOHIGHLEVEL VA — CLIENT ONBOARDING & WEBSITE SETUP (Part-Time, Freelance, Room to Grow)



Hi! I run an early-stage agency building websites and lead-generation systems for trade businesses — builders, roofers, concreters, plasterers. I'm hiring my first tea
mber to own client onboarding inside GoHighLevel.



A BIT ABOUT ME — I'm Isaiah i'm 29, and for most of my 20s I had no purpose. I always knew I wanted to build something more, but I didn't have the direction — only distraction. I started investing in real estate and became a team leader in my role working with high-risk youth. Then I found this. Building and learning business has become my purpose: a way to keep mastering myself, one day look after the people I love, and help others live up to their full potential too. What I love most is leadership: building a tight team, chasing a clear goal, and celebrating the wins together — with everyone benefiting and growing. If that fires you up, you're my kind of person.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (THE DAY-TO-DAY):

- Take each new client from the onboarding form and spin up their account from our snapshot/template in GoHighLevel.

- Build out the client's website using the onboarding info plus our SOPs (mostly templated — you're customising, not designing from blank).

- Set up their workflows, review-management, and lead-follow-up automations (largely copy-paste from the template).

-Optimize their google business profile (SOP)

- Chase clients for any missing info, photos, or documents before it holds up the build.

- Move clients cleanly through the pipeline and send me a short daily update (done / doing / stuck).

- Use AI tools (like Claude) daily to work faster.

- Full training provided — no prior GoHighLevel experience needed.



Most of the system is already built — the snapshots, the workflows, the SOPs. You are NOT inventing it from scratch; you're running it cleanly and consistently, client after client, and catching anything that's missing before it becomes a problem. Precision and follow-through matter more here than creativity.



Your pay grows as the agency grows. You win when we win — and I mean that literally, it's written into how you're paid:



WHAT YOU GET:

- A real culture, not a faceless gig. You're employee #1, working shoulder-to-shoulder with me. Your wins get noticed, your ideas shape how we do things, and I want someone who genuinely enjoys the work — not someone counting down the clock. Work hard with me and you'll feel it in how you're trusted, treated, and paid.

- A monthly retainer that secures your availability, covers our weekly Zoom, light ongoing upkeep, and helping refine the SOPs so they run smoothly for you.

- Project-based pay per client you onboard — a fair flat fee for each onboarding, confirmed with you on our call. The more clients we land, the more you earn.

- Milestone bonuses tied to client growth — as the agency hits new client milestones, your pay grows with it.

- Free, hands-on training in GoHighLevel, AI tools, and agency systems — skills that raise your market value permanently.

- A clear path: first hire today, then lead VA / operations as we grow.

- Flexible part-time hours (10-20/week to start, growing with the business).

- A 90-day performance review. High-performing tea
mbers will be considered for increased responsibilities and bonuses and pay increases. 



THE GROWTH PATH (THE REAL OPPORTUNITY):

You'll start by following my recorded walkthroughs and SOPs. The system is nearly all documented — you'll just help me put the final polish on a few SOPs so they work smoothly for you. Once you've onboarded a few clients and know the system cold, you'll own it — improving the SOPs and eventually overseeing onboarding end to end. As we land more clients, this role grows from first VA to lead VA / operations. The person who runs the engine well is the person who ends up managing it.



THE SETUP, PLAINLY: this is a freelance / contract role to start — you invoice me, rather than being a salaried employee, and it's part-time and fully remote. I call you a "tea
mber" because that's genuinely how I'll treat you, but I want to be straight: it's contract-based, with a real path to a long-term core role (and more pay) as the agency grows.



WHAT YOU NEED (attitude over skills — I'll train the rest):

You do NOT need GoHighLevel experience. What I can't train is who you are. You DO need:

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- A growth mindset — you want to learn AI, automation, and marketing, and keep levelling up.

- Problem-solving — when something's missing or breaks, you think it through and find a fix before running to me. Bring solutions, not just problems.

- Leadership potential — you want to grow into leading: owning processes, and eventually helping run and train a small team.

- Consistency — this is a repeatable system you'll run again and again; you do it the same right way every time.

- Reliability and punctuality — you do what you say when you say, and you show up on time, every time, to our weekly Zoom check-in.

- Sharp attention to detail and the ability to follow instructions exactly.

- Comfort working async — outside our weekly Zoom we won't always be online together (I work a rotating shift roster). You'll send a short daily update and work from recorded Loom videos, keeping things moving on your own — while flagging when you're genuinely stuck instead of going silent.



START DATE: as soon as I find the right person — ideally within the next 2-3 weeks. I'm finishing training materials now, so you'll step into a system that's ready for you.



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — this is the first test):

1. Record a 1-minute video telling me: (a) why you'd be great for this role, and (b) something you taught yourself in the last year and exactly how you learned it. Upload to Loom or Google Drive and make sure the link is viewable.

2. Start your application with the word: CONCRETE

3. Include: your video link, a short personal intro (no copy-paste cover letters — I can tell instantly), your rate expectation, and an internet speed test screenshot (speedtest.net).



Applications that skip the video or the code word won't be read. That's deliberate — following instructions exactly is the job. 



Thank you, and I look forward to reviewing your application.

title: Product Development Manager – Premium DTC Hardware Brand (Remote)
description:
----About Us----

We’re a fast-scaling DTC brand that grew from $100K to $800K+ per month and are on track for 8-figures in the next 12–18 months. We build premium consumer hardware, engineered to compete with top power-tool brands. Our product team includes ex-Dyson engineers, and we manufacture with factories that also produce for brands like TTI (Ryobi, Milwaukee)



We’re rolling out upgraded versions, a new product line, and new upsell products. We need a Product Development Manager to own that pipeline end-to-end so the founders are not juggling samples, tooling, and timelines.



----The Mission----

Own the hardware launch pipeline from concept to mass production.



You are the single point of contact between:

- R&D / industrial design agency

- Engineering partners (incl. Dyson talent)

- Factories and suppliers

- Internal ops, creative, and founders



Founders set the target (“Launch the PRO version in October.”). You build and run the plan to make it real: on time, on spec, on budget.



----What You’ll Own----

- Full product lifecycle: concept, design, prototyping, testing, sampling, tooling, pre-production, launch.

- Manage R&D / product & branding agency and engineering partners.

- Own factory relationships on the development side: specs, samples, QC standards, tooling/molds.

- Source and qualify new suppliers/factories for new products (this is your department, not ops).

 -Run the product roadmap and launch calendar; keep multiple launches moving in parallel.

- Oversee product documentation, design patents, and IP with our legal partners.

- Drive quality and engineering standards that match premium power-tool brands.

- Coordinate with ops (stock-in dates), creative (launch assets), and founders (direction, trade-offs).



----You’re a Fit If You Have----

- 3+ years in product development / product management for physical consumer products.

- Ideal: consumer electronics, power tools, appliances, or hardware.

- Proven track record taking products from concept and tooling through to mass production.

- Direct experience managing Asian factories and engineering teams on development (not just reorders).

- Strong grasp of injection molding, tooling, materials, and DFM (design for manufacturing).

- Experience coordinating agencies, designers, and engineers across time zones.

- Excellent English and clear, structured communication.

- Bonus: background with a premium hardware brand (Dyson, DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, etc.).



----You’ll Excel Here If----

- You ship: launches land on time and on spec, not “soon.”

- You obsess over quality and sweat engineering details.

- You can manage controlled chaos across multiple launches without dropping anything.

- You want to grow into a Head of Product role as the line expands.



Logistics

- Full-time, remote, long-term.

- US or European time-zone overlap preferred.

- Competitive USD compensation based on experience and track record.



----HOW TO APPLY----

Send us:

(1) MUST: A 1-minute fresh Loom video where you:

- Share specific physical products you’ve taken from concept to mass production (your role + results).

- Explain why you’re the perfect fit and what makes you an A-player.

- Show your communication style and personality.



Please don’t script this with ChatGPT – we want to see how YOU think.



(2) A link to your CV + portfolio with products you’ve shipped and your specific responsibilities on each.



(3) Subject line: Product Development Manager – [Your Name]



This is not seasonal work. We’re building a real brand and want someone who wants to grow with us long-term.

title: WANTED: Influencer & Content Manager (Part Time -> Full Time)
description:
This isn't your typical "social media manager" role where you're stuck making Canva graphics or editing Reels all day.



You'll be the architect of our content sourcing machine – building real relationships with creators, negotiating deals, and ensuring we never run out of fresh, high-converting content. 



If you thrive on outreach, love the hustle of closing partnerships, and can juggle 20+ creator relationships without breaking a sweat – this role was built for you.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT: 

- Most brands treat influencer managers as order-takers. 

- We need a proactive A-player who sees opportunities before we do. 

- Someone who doesn't wait for instructions but brings ideas, systems, and results to the table. 

- You'll have full ownership of our creator pipeline – from cold DM to delivered assets – and the autonomy to build processes that scale as we grow.



THE WORK: 

Your #1 mission is simple: keep our content flowing nonstop. 



You'll source creators constantly (Instagram, TikTok,
, Influee – whatever works), negotiate collaborations (UGC, gifting, paid partnerships, affiliate deals), and manage every relationship from first contact to final delivery. 



You'll also handle light social media management – reposting creator stories, responding to DMs – to keep our Instagram alive and engaged. 



This is a relationship-driven, high-energy role where your people skills and hustle directly impact our growth.



WHO YOU ARE: 

- You have experience working with influencers or creators (or a strong SMM background with outreach experience). 

- Your English is fluent!!! – you're comfortable on calls, recording Loom videos, and writing professional outreach messages. 

- You're an extrovert who loves building relationships and moving fast. 

- Creators enjoy working with you because you're responsive, professional, and fun. 

- You're proactive, organized, and can manage multiple partnerships simultaneously without dropping the ball. Most importantly, you bring ideas, not just execution – you see what's working in the market and adapt quickly.



WHAT WE OFFER: 

- $4–8/hour base (depending on experience) + performance bonuses tied to content delivery and results. 

- 100% remote with a part-time to full-time growth path – start part-time, prove your impact, scale to full-time. 

- You'll have training, support, and autonomy to build systems that work. 



This isn't seasonal – we're building something big and looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

This role won't be the right fit if:

- You're a video editor or creative strategist – this is about sourcing and relationships, not content creation

- Your English isn't fluent enough for calls, Loom videos, and professional creator outreach

- You don't have proven experience with creator outreach and relationship management

- You're not proactive – we need someone who brings ideas, not just follows orders

- You're slow to respond or hard to reach – speed and communication are critical

- You're looking for a temporary or seasonal gig – we're building for the long haul





ABOUT US

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the electronics space with products that have earned a loyal following. Now we need someone to fuel our growth with a constant stream of fresh, high-quality creator content. We operate with speed, precision, and premium positioning in everything we do.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Constantly source new creators through outreach on Instagram, TikTok,
, DMs, Influee – whatever gets results

- Negotiate collaborations (UGC, gifting, paid partnerships, affiliate deals) and close agreements

- Manage creator relationships: follow-ups, deadlines, content delivery, and quality control

- Keep our Instagram active: repost creator stories, respond to DMs, maintain engagement

- Build systems and SOPs as we scale – document what works and propose improvements

- Track key metrics: outreach volume, response rates, content delivered, ROI

- Bring fresh ideas on how to get more content faster and more efficiently





HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. A 1-minute FRESH LOOM VIDEO where you:

- Share results you've achieved (deals closed, content sourced, growth metrics)

Please do not use ChatGPT or similar tools to script your answers – we want to genuinely get to know you and how you communicate and think! (We do love integrating these tools into our work though, and you'll hear plenty about that once you join us.)

title: Marketing Coordinator - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn’t exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation’s largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we’re actively building — and leading.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice’s behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We’re changing that — and we’re looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We’re actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready.



Position Overview:

The Marketing Coordinator (Remote) supports the US-based marketing team in executing and managing digital campaigns that drive lead generation, brand visibility, and sales pipeline for MP1 Solutions. This role is responsible for day-to-day campaign execution, marketing automation, content coordination, and performance reporting across multiple digital channels. The ideal candidate is highly organized, tech-savvy, comfortable with US-facing B2B content, and eager to work in a fast-paced healthcare compliance environment at the forefront of AI-integrated marketing.



Key Responsibilities:

• Campaign Execution Support — Assist in building and launching digital marketing campaigns including
 sequences, lead nurturing workflows, and landing pages. Ensure accurate scheduling, QA checklists, and on-time delivery across all campaigns.

• Marketing Automation — Build, manage, and optimize
 campaigns in Pardot (Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement). Maintain audience segments, lead scoring rules, and campaign tagging aligned with the US sales team.

• Landing Page & Web Updates — Manage landing page updates in Unbounce and WordPress; coordinate with the design team to publish forms, update tracking codes, and implement A/B test variants.

• AI Tool Support — Assist in researching, testing, and applying AI-powered tools to streamline content creation, audience targeting, and campaign workflows. Document tool performance and contribute to the team's AI adoption roadmap.

• Content Coordination — Coordinate with content writers and designers to ensure campaign assets 
 copy, graphics, CTAs) are delivered on time and meet brand standards. Light copywriting and proofreading required.

• Analytics & Reporting — Track and compile campaign performance data (open rates, CTR, conversions, lead volume). Prepare weekly/monthly reporting summaries for the US marketing leadership team.

• Project Management — Manage assigned tasks and campaign schedules in Asana. Communicate proactively with the US team on progress, blockers, and status updates.



Minimum Requirements:

• 3–5+ years of experience in digital marketing, campaign coordination, or marketing operations

• Hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform (Pardot, HubSpot, Mailchimp, or equivalent)

• Proficiency with WordPress and/or landing page builders (Unbounce, Webflow, or similar)

• Knowledge of HTML/CSS basics helpful for
 template editing

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or equivalent experience



Compensation:

• 100% remote opportunity — work from the Philippines supporting a growing US-based healthcare compliance company

• Paid Time Off (PTO)

For each product line within the sourcing workbook, the analyst will identify and document:



Exact like-for-like product matches where available

Supplier name and contact details

Supplier SKU and product hyperlink

Cost price and pack size

Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)

Estimated lead time

Freight assumptions

Unit of Measure (UOM) validation

Product classification (Like-for-Like, Alternate or Not Found)

SDS, compliance or certification requirements where applicable



Analysts must validate manufacturer-specific products with approved suppliers including Agar, SC Johnson/Diversey, Kimberly-Clark, Tork, Oates, Sabco and Truvox where required.



A strong focus should be placed on data accuracy, supplier consolidation opportunities, compliance validation and identification of cost-saving opportunities. The final output will provide a clean, structured sourcing database that supports procurement decision-making, supplier rationalisation and category management initiatives.

title: SEO / AEO Full-Stack Specialist
description:
# SEO / AEO Full-Stack Specialist



**Company:** Moredemand

**Location:** Remote (UK-based preferred)

**Type:** Full-time



---



## The Role



We're hiring a full-stack SEO and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) specialist to own organic visibility across a portfolio of brands spanning SaaS, regulated financial services, and personal brand properties.



This isn't a "write meta titles and build links" role. The search landscape has fundamentally shifted. Google is embedding AI overviews. ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude are becoming primary research tools for buyers. The line between ranking on a SERP and being cited by an LLM is disappearing — and we need someone who operates across both.



You'll be responsible for making sure our brands show up wherever people and machines are looking for answers — traditional search, AI-generated responses, voice, and conversational discovery.



---



## What You'll Own



**Search Engine Optimisation**



- Technical SEO across multiple Next.js and WordPress properties — crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, internal linking architecture

- Keyword strategy and content planning tied directly to commercial intent and funnel stage

- On-page optimisation at scale — not just blog posts, but landing pages, tool pages, comparison pages, and programmatic content

- Link acquisition strategy that doesn't rely on guest post spam — digital PR, data-led content, strategic partnerships

- Reporting and forecasting that connects organic traffic to pipeline and revenue, not just impressions



**Answer Engine Optimisation**



- Structuring content and site architecture so LLMs can accurately extract, attribute, and cite our brands

- Schema markup, entity optimisation, and knowledge graph presence

- Monitoring brand representation across AI search tools (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot)

- Building topical authority signals that influence how AI models categorise and recommend our products

- Testing and iterating on content formats that perform in both traditional and AI-driven discovery



**Full-Stack Execution**



- You can brief writers, but you can also build pages. Comfortable working in code (HTML, CSS, basic JS/React) to implement changes without waiting on a dev queue

- Able to spin up landing pages, adjust templates, deploy schema, and configure CMS structures independently

- Data analysis in GA4, Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush, and custom dashboards — pulling insight, not just reporting numbers

- Comfortable with AI tooling in your own workflow — using Claude, GPT, or similar to accelerate research, content production, and technical audits



---



## What We're Looking For



- 3+ years in SEO with demonstrable commercial results (traffic that turned into revenue, not just rankings)

- Working knowledge of AEO principles — even if the discipline is new, you should already be thinking about how AI search changes the game

- Technical competence — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to be able to read and edit code, work with APIs, and implement changes in a codebase without hand-holding

- Experience in regulated industries (finance, insurance, legal) is a strong advantage — you understand what YMYL means in practice, not just in theory

- Strong commercial instinct — you think in terms of demand capture and conversion, not just traffic volume

- Self-directed and low-maintenance — we operate lean and move fast, you won't have a manager checking in daily



---



## The Stack



- **Sites:** Next.js (App Router), WordPress

- **Hosting:** Vercel, Cloudflare

- **Analytics:** GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, custom dashboards

- **Content:** Claude API, Notion, markdown-first workflows

- **Dev:** GitHub, VS Code, Claude Code

- **CRM/Data:** PostgreSQL, Stripe, Clerk



---



## What You Get



- Direct ownership of organic and AI discovery across a portfolio doing real volume (500,000+ customers acquired through paid — now building the organic engine to match)

- Exposure to SaaS product development, regulated financial services, and personal brand growth — not a single-vertical silo

- A founder who understands marketing at a technical level — you won't be explaining what a canonical tag is

- Autonomy to build the playbook, not just follow one

- Competitive salary based on experience, with performance-based upside



---



## How to Apply



Send a short note (not a cover letter essay) explaining:



1. One organic growth result you're genuinely proud of — what you did, what moved, and why it mattered commercially

2. Your take on how AI search changes SEO strategy over the next 12–18 months

3. A link to something you've built or optimised that we can look at



Send to: **
 address]**



No agencies. No "I'd love to connect" LinkedIn messages. Just the work.

title: Real Estate Hunter- Commission Only- Oklahoma City Market- Remote
description:
This is a pure outbound sales role. No base pay. No hand-holding. Just results.



Top performers have the potential to earn $9,950 in a single quarter. Here's how.

The machine is already built. A fully loaded GoHighLevel CRM with scripts and objection handlers is ready to go. A live funnel with leads already coming in is waiting. All deal attribution is tracked with timestamps — no gray area, no guesswork.

Your job is to find qualified leads, book appointments, and work the system consistently. The pipeline is warm and you can be making calls in week one. Everything else is already in place.



About This Opportunity

Hi, I'm Jaz Sale — a licensed real estate agent based in Oklahoma City, active investor, and STR operator. I'm looking for a reliable, self-motivated hunter to join my team long-term.

This is a pure outbound sales role. Your primary job is to find motivated sellers and qualified buyers through cold outreach — expired listings, FSBOs, circle prospecting, and direct cold calling — and book them as qualified appointments on my calendar. You will also follow up with warm inbound leads coming in from my social media.

But make no mistake — this role is built for someone who loves the hunt. If you're not comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day, this is not the right fit.



What a Qualified Lead Looks Like

A qualified lead is someone who has a real need — buying or selling in OKC in the next 30-90 days — has been contacted by you, is logged in GoHighLevel, and has agreed to a scheduled appointment with me.

You do not get credit for a name and number. You get credit for a booked, qualified conversation.



Compensation — 100% Performance Based

This is a straight commission role. There is no base pay. Your income is directly tied to your results — which means your ceiling is completely uncapped.

Strong performers have the potential to earn $9,950 in a single quarter. Here's the breakdown:

Example — Strong Quarter (8 deals at Tier 3):



8 × $800 = $6,400 + $1,500 quarterly bonus = $7,900

Per-Deal Commission — Tiered by Performance:



Starter — Deal 1 — $400

Growing — Deals 2-5 — $650

Established — Deal 6+ — $800



Quarterly Production Bonuses:



Close 3 deals in a quarter — +$500

Close 5 deals in a quarter — +$1,000

Close 8+ deals in a quarter — +$1,500



Real estate deals take 30-60 days to close from when a lead is set. Strong performers typically see their first commission hit by week six — and the pipeline compounds from there. The people who stay consistent are the ones who see it pay off fast.

On the 1099 arrangement — this is an independent contractor role and that is intentional. 1099 means you control your schedule, your upside is completely uncapped, and there is no ceiling a W-2 would put on your earnings. The people who thrive here treat this like their own business — because it is.



What You'll Be Doing



Prospect for motivated sellers daily — expired listings, FSBOs, circle prospecting, cold outreach

Generate and follow up with buyer leads across multiple channels

Follow up with warm inbound leads from social media

Qualify leads and book appointments directly on my calendar

Log all activity in GoHighLevel CRM — full training provided

Nurture cold leads until they are ready to move

Communicate professionally on behalf of my brand at all times





Activity Expectations

This role has a minimum daily floor — not a target, a floor.



First 30 days: 50+ outbound touches per day minimum while learning the scripts and system

After 30 days: 75+ daily touches minimum — every single day



Outbound touches include cold calls, texts, DMs, and
s combined. If you have done real outbound sales before this is completely normal. If this sounds like a lot this role probably is not the right fit.



Who We're Looking For



Experience in real estate lead gen, cold calling, or outbound sales — strongly preferred

Comfortable picking up the phone and calling strangers every single day without being asked

Self-directed — you manage your own time and hit your numbers without being chased

Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace for calls

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience is a plus

Strong written and verbal English communication

Must be available during US business hours — CST preferred. Minimum 6-hour overlap with 8 AM - 6 PM CST required

Honest about what you know and hungry to learn what you don't





Important Details



Deal credit is clearly defined — you make first contact, log it in GoHighLevel, and book a qualified appointment that leads to a close. All tracked with timestamps. No gray area.

1099 independent contractor arrangement

You set your own schedule — we care about results, not hours

Scripts and objection handlers provided — you are not starting from scratch

Full GoHighLevel CRM training included

Strong performers will be considered for expanded roles and higher earning potential over time. This is a long-term opportunity, not a short contract.





How to Apply — Two Steps, Both Required

nt we find the right candidate — not on a schedule. Don't wait.

JOB OVERVIEW:

We are a premium fitness company operating TWO studio locations in California, anchored by expert personal training and complemented by boxing, yoga, strength training, and calisthenics. We are hiring a Sales-Focused Virtual Assistant to be our dedicated closer across BOTH locations — owning every lead from first touch to signed membership, AND proactively building a B2B pipeline for corporate wellness and group programs.



This is a high-leverage role: two studios, two lead pools, two markets — and uncapped commission across all of it. If you are a hunter who loves the phone, the close, and the commission check, keep reading.



If you are looking for a "sit back and reply to
s" job, this is NOT for you.



------------------------------------------------------------

WORKING HOURS

------------------------------------------------------------

Monday through Friday, 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Pacific Time (US).

This is non-negotiable — it covers our peak lead and member-acquisition window across both locations.



------------------------------------------------------------

COMPENSATION — BASE + UNCAPPED COMMISSION

------------------------------------------------------------



BASE SALARY:

USD $600 per month, paid bi-monthly via Wise or Payoneer.



COMMISSION STRUCTURE — PERCENTAGE-BASED, UNCAPPED:



TIER A — PERSONAL TRAINING PACKAGES (our flagship service)

8% of the total contract value of every PT package you close.



   Examples:

   - 3-month PT package at $1,800 sold:    $144 commission

   - 6-month PT package at $3,600 sold:    $288 commission

   - 12-month PT package at $7,200 sold:   $576 commission

   - Premium custom PT ($10,000+):         $800+ commission



TIER B — GROUP STUDIO MEMBERSHIPS (Boxing, Yoga, Strength, Calisthenics)

6% of the first 12 months of contract value on every new membership you close.



   Examples:

   - Month-to-month at $179/mo (12 mo value = $2,148):    $129 commission

   - 6-month commitment at $159/mo ($1,908 value):        $115 commission

   - 12-month commitment at $139/mo ($1,668 value):       $100 commission



TIER C — B2B / CORPORATE WELLNESS — THE BIG MONEY TIER

12% of total contract value on every B2B deal you source AND close.



   This is corporate wellness packages, team training, group programs for companies, executive PT for C-suite teams, and any business-to-business contract.



   Examples:

   - 10-employee corporate wellness package at $8,000:    $960 commission

   - 25-employee team training program at $20,000:        $2,400 commission

   - Annual corporate retainer at $36,000:                $4,320 commission



   We are based in the Bay Area / Silicon Valley — tech companies, startups, and professional firms within 25 miles are all in play. The B2B pipeline is wide open. Whoever builds it wins.



TIER D — PIPELINE-BUILDING BONUSES (paid even before the close)

- $5 per fully qualified inbound opportunity added to the pipeline (BANT-qualified: budget confirmed, decision-maker reached, timeline established, fit confirmed).

- $25 per booked B2B discovery call (verified decision-maker, company size 25+ employees, scheduled on a real calendar).

- $100 milestone bonus when you source, qualify, AND close a B2B deal entirely on your own outreach.



TIER E — MONTHLY VOLUME BONUSES (stack on top of all commission above)

- 10+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$100 bonus

- 20+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$300 bonus

- 30+ memberships closed in a calendar month:   +$800 bonus



TIER F — MULTI-LOCATION BONUS

- $100 monthly bonus when KPIs are hit across BOTH studio locations.





REALISTIC EARNING POTENTIAL:

With two studios feeding the pipeline and B2B in play, a strong closer can realistically earn USD $2,000–$4,500 in commission per month ON TOP of base. Top performers who land 1–2 B2B deals per quarter can exceed USD $5,000/month in total compensation. Uncapped. Period.



PAYMENT TERMS:

- Base paid on the 1st and 15th.

- Commission paid the month following the close, after the customer's first payment clears.

- Pipeline bonuses paid monthly with base.

- 14-day clawback window if a sale is refunded.



------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU WILL DO

------------------------------------------------------------



INBOUND SALES (across both locations)

- Respond to every inbound lead within 5 minutes during your shift — SMS,
, DM, phone.

- Qualify leads using our discovery framework.

- Book or close — your call based on the lead's heat.

- Run discovery calls, present the right package, handle objections, close the sale.

- Send agreements via DocuSign and follow up until signed and paid.



NURTURE & RECOVERY

- Day 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 manual follow-up sequence on every unconverted lead.

- Re-engage cold leads from the last 12 months.

- Win back churned members from the last 6 months.



B2B OUTBOUND PIPELINE-BUILDING (high-leverage)

- Build a target list of 100+ Bay Area companies (25–500 employees) within 10 miles of our locations.

- Cold outreach via LinkedIn,
, and phone to HR leaders, People Ops, and Founders.

- Pitch corporate wellness, team training, executive PT, and group programs.

- Book discovery calls on the owners' calendar.

- Own the deal cycle from first touch to signed contract.



CRM HYGIENE & REPORTING

- Real-time pipeline updates across both locations.

- Weekly sales report every Friday: leads, calls, consults, deals closed, commission earned, B2B pipeline status.



------------------------------------------------------------

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

------------------------------------------------------------



ENGLISH:

- Fluent, near-native spoken and written English.

- NEUTRAL ACCENT REQUIRED — must sound clear and professional to American customers, including corporate decision-makers. Your audio sample (see "How to Apply") is the first thing we review.



SALES EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum 2 years of phone-based sales experience.

- Strong preference for: fitness sales, gy
mberships, personal training sales, wellness, beauty, med spa, real estate, insurance, or high-ticket B2C closing.

- B2B experience is a major plus.

- Proven track record hitting quota — be ready to share specific numbers.



PERSONALITY:

- Friendly. People should feel like you actually care, because you do.

- Dynamic. High-energy, naturally enthusiastic, the kind of voice that makes someone smile through the phone.

- Resilient. Rejection sharpens you, not breaks you.

- Hungry. You want the commission and you'll do the work to earn it.

- Coachable. Feedback is fuel.



TECHNICAL:

PREFERRED (BONUS — NOT REQUIRED):

mber, PT client, or fitness enthusiast.

- Prior B2B prospecting or cold outreach experience.



------------------------------------------------------------

WHO WILL HATE THIS JOB

------------------------------------------------------------

- People who don't want their performance measured in numbers.

- People who think 12–8 PM Pacific is "too late" (3 AM – 11 AM Manila — yes, schedule shift required).

If those bullets felt seen — please do not apply.



------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS SECTION CAREFULLY

This is an ongoing, long-term full-time role with consistent hours, full training, and a step-by-step playbook provided. If you're dependable and take pride in doing things accurately, you'll do great here.



## Schedule



- **Full-time: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday** (20 hours/week)

- **Hours:** approximately **8:00 PM – 12:00 AM Philippine Time** (this matches my US morning; it may shift by one hour during US daylight saving changes)

- Consistent schedule every week

) through my posting system.

- **Excellent spoken and written English** — you'll be calling and texting US agents, so this is important.

- **Comfortable making phone calls.**

- **Basic video editing ability** (CapCut) — or a fast learner willing to be trained.

- **Reliable, organized, and detail-oriented** — my videos follow exact specs, so accuracy matters.

- Stable internet and a quiet space for calls.

- Able to work the set hours consistently.



## Nice to have (not required)

- Experience with social media scheduling tools (GoHighLevel, Hootsuite, Later, etc.).

title: Virtual Assistant- Social Media, Content and marketing.
description:
STEPHAN OLIVIER PHOTOGRAPHY & TOURS

Campbell River, BC  |  British Columbia and African Safaris



Virtual Assistant - Social Media, Content and Marketing

Part-time  |  10-15 hrs/week  |  Long-term  |  Remote

Immediate Start



About the Business

I'm Stephan, a wildlife and safari photographer based in Campbell River, British Columbia, Canada. I run Stephan Olivier Photography and Tours - a boutique photography and adventure tour business operating across two worlds: British Colombia, Canada wildlife tours featuring grizzly bears, eagles, whales, and marine wildlife, and photographic safaris to Africa - South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Tanzania, and Kenya.

My clients are photographers and wildlife lovers from across North America, the UK, and Europe. We run photographic tours, workshops, family holidays, couples getaways, and honeymoon packages. The business is growing and I need help building the online presence and marketing engine that matches the quality of the experiences we deliver.



The Role

I'm looking for a reliable, creative VA who can take work off my plate and run with it. You'll be working directly with me across social media, content creation, video editing,
 marketing, and marketing setup. This is a long-term position - I'm not looking for someone to hand off a one-time project. I want someone who learns the brand, grows with the business, and becomes a real part of the team.

This starts at 10-15 hours per week with room to grow. If you're the right person, this won't stay small.



What You'll Be Doing

Social Media (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)

• Creating and scheduling carousel posts - we aim for 2 to 3 per week

• Writing captions that sound human and on-brand - wildlife stories, safari 
nts, photography tips

• Repurposing existing content across platforms

• Managing hashtags, scheduling, and basic engagement

• Tracking what's working and flagging it to me



Video Editing and Content Creation

• Editing wildlife and safari footage into polished short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

• Adding music, text overlays, colour grading - keeping it cinematic and on-brand

• Pulling clips from raw footage and turning them into multiple content pieces

• Creating Canva graphics for carousels, marketing materials, and promotional content



 Marketing (Kit / formerly ConvertKit)

• Writing and scheduling
 campaigns and newsletters

• Helping set up automations, sequences, and welcome flows

• Keeping the
 list organised and segmented



Marketing and Systems Setup

• Helping build and maintain a content calendar

• Light updates to our Squarespace website

• Supporting tour promotions on the WeTravel booking platform

• Setting up workflows and templates so content creation gets faster over time



Who You Are

You don't need to be an expert in everything from day one - but you do need to be a fast learner with a genuine interest in wildlife, photography, travel, or the outdoors. The brand has a distinct voice and visual style, and I need someone who cares enough to get it right.

You are the right fit if you:

• Have real experience managing social media accounts - not just posting, but strategically growing them

• Know Canva well and can work from brand assets (logo, colour palette, style guide)

• Have video editing experience - CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere, or similar

• Can write in a natural, authentic voice - not corporate, not robotic

• Are proactive and self-directed - you ask good questions, flag problems early, and don't need hand-holding on every task

• Are comfortable with Kit (ConvertKit), or willing to learn it quickly

• Have reliable internet and a dedicated work setup

• Are available for a short weekly check-in and respond to messages promptly



Bonus points if you:

• Have worked with a travel, photography, outdoor, or safari brand before

• Know Squarespace or similar website platforms

• Have experience with WeTravel or any booking or tour platform

• Have photography knowledge or a genuine passion for wildlife



Tools We Use

• Instagram, TikTok, YouTube

• Canva (brand account with assets ready)

• Kit (ConvertKit) for
 marketing

• Squarespace for the website

• WeTravel for tour bookings

• Outlook for

• Video editor of your choice (CapCut, DaVinci, Premiere, etc.)



Compensation and Details

• Part-time: 10-15 hours per week to start

• Long-term position - we're building something, not just filling a gap

• Rate - Starting rate is $
/month depending on experience, with room to grow as the business grows

• Paid directly via Wise, or PayPal

• Regular weekly check-ins via video call



How to Apply

If this sounds like you, I want to hear from you. Please don't send a generic application - I read every message and I can tell immediately when someone has actually read the post.

In your message, include:

• A short introduction - who you are, where you're based, and why this role interests you

• Links to social media accounts or content you have managed or created

• Examples of video edits you have done (personal projects count)

• Your availability and time zone

One last thing: Start your message with the words "Into the Wild" so I know you read this all the way through. Anyone who doesn't include it won't be considered.

This is a genuine long-term opportunity with a small business that does meaningful work. If you're looking for something you can be proud of and a role where your effort actually shows - this is it.



Thank you for applying.  

Kind Regards

Stephan

Campbell River, BC, Canada

title: Finance Controller / Bookkeeping & AP-AR Manager — Fast-Growing DTC E-Commerce Brand (Remote)
description:
About Us

We're a fast-scaling direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand (Shopify) that has grown from $100K to $800K+ per month and is on track to 8-figures in the next 12–18 months. We sell physical products globally, run paid media at scale, and work with multiple agencies and suppliers. We move fast, we run lean, and we obsess over numbers. We're now building out our finance function and need someone to own the day-to-day money operations so the founders can stop touching invoices.



The Role

You'll be the person who keeps our finances clean, organized, and on time. EVERY DAY.

You own accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice management, payment preparation, and bookkeeping coordination. You will NOT have authority to move money on your own. Every payment you prepare goes to a founder for final approval. You're the engine; the founders keep the keys.



What You'll Own

- Manage a central accounting inbox — receive, organize, and log every vendor invoice

- Prepare payments in our banking platforms (Slash, Airwallex, Chase) for founder approval — never execute without sign-off

- Track all recurring vendors (marketing agencies, ad platforms, software, contractors) and flag anything off-pattern

- Maintain a clean, real-time AP aging report — we never want a surprise on what we owe

- Reconcile Shopify payouts, merchant fees, and bank statements

- Coordinate with our external bookkeeper/accountant (monthly close, P&L, categorization questions)

- Keep our expense categorization correct: ads vs. marketing agencies vs. R&D vs. operating expenses are NOT the same bucket — you'll learn our framework and protect it

- Maintain spreadsheets/trackers for cash position, upcoming payments, and vendor spend

- Help prepare monthly financial reports and budget sheets as you grow into the role



You're a Fit If You Have

- 2+ years in bookkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, or finance operations for an e-commerce or DTC business

- Hands-on experience with QuickBooks (or similar) and reconciling high transaction volume

- Comfort working inside Shopify, modern banking apps, and payment platforms

- Sharp attention to detail. You catch the $54 fee, the double-charge, the miscategorized expense

- Strong English, clear written communication, and the discipline to stay on top of deadlines without being chased

- A security-first mindset. You understand why second approvals exist and you never cut corners

- Bonus: experience with Triple Whale, e-commerce P&L structures, or working with US-based entities



What Makes You Excel Here

- You're proactive — you flag problems before they become problems

- You're organized to the point of being a little obsessive about it

- You want to grow into a senior finance role as the company scales, not stay a button-pusher



Logistics

- Full-time, remote, long-term

- Significant overlap with US/European hours preferred

- Compensation based on experience





HOW TO APPLY

Send us:



(1) A 1-minute FRESH LOOM VIDEO where you:

- Share your experience with bookkeeping / AP-AR and the size of business you've handled

- Explain why you're the perfect fit and what makes you an A-player

- Show us your communication style and personality



Please don't script this with ChatGPT — we want to genuinely get to know YOU and how you think.

(2) A link to your CV

(3) Subject line: Finance Controller – [Your Name]



This isn't seasonal work. We're building something big and looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.

title: Create AI Social Media Content (AI UGC, Slideshows, etc)
description:
We’re hiring Virtual Assistants to help fulfil social media campaigns for Fastlane, our AI content platform and managed content agency.



Fastlane helps brands create and run networks of TikTok and Instagram accounts. When a client comes to us, we build a content strategy for them, create the accounts, generate content inside Fastlane, schedule the posts, review performance, and communicate with the client on Slack.



The work would involve helping with:



- Creating content strategies for clients

- Planning the types of accounts we should run for each client

- Creating content inside Fastlane

- Scheduling posts across TikTok and Instagram

- Helping manage client communication in Slack

- Reviewing what content is working and suggesting improvements



Everything is done inside Fastlane, and we will train you fully on how the platform works.



To explain the work more clearly, for each client we usually create a network of accounts. These are commonly:



AI influencer pages: For example, if the client is a fitness app, we might create a persona like “Sophie Gym,” generate images of Sophie using Fastlane, and then create videos of Sophie promoting fitness, routines, workouts, diet tips, and other relevant content.



General theme pages: These are broader niche pages, such as fitness tips pages, 
 pages, educational pages, or trend pages. On these accounts we post a mix of AI UGC videos, 
s, slideshows, product demos, and high-retention text-based videos.



The process usually looks like this:



1. A client comes to us and wants daily content.

2. We create a strategy showing which accounts we will run, what each account’s angle is, and what kind of content will be posted.

3. The client approves the strategy.

4. We create 7 days worth of content inside Fastlane.

5. We schedule the content inside Fastlane.

6. We track what performed well that week, and once the 7 days are up, we do it again



You don’t need to know Fastlane already. We’ll train you on everything. But it would be helpful if you’re comfortable with TikTok, Instagram, social media trends, short-form video, 
s, AI tools, and client communication.



You can also sign up for free at 
 and try the platform yourself to understand how content creation works.



We’re looking for someone who is detail-oriented, creative, reliable, fast to learn, and comfortable working with clients over Slack.



If this sounds interesting, please reply with:



- Your experience with TikTok, Instagram, or short-form content

- Any experience with AI tools or content creation platforms

- Whether you’ve handled client communication before

- Your hourly or monthly rate

- A few examples of social media work you’ve done, if available



If you have examples of AI videos or AI UGC videos you've made, please share them and describe exactly how you made those videos. Our clients are mostly consumer software companies as well as some physical products.



Thanks,

Gaurav

description:
Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist



We're an established meta ads marketing agency looking for a high-volume Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist who can create direct-response static ad creatives for paid social campaigns.



This is not a slow branding role. This is a fast-paced, production-based creative role for someone who can move quickly, follow briefs, use AI tools, and produce a high volume of clean, usable ad creatives every day.



We work with fast-growing brands and move quickly as a team. We care deeply about client results, clear communication, strong execution, and high standards. We want someone who takes ownership of their work, stays organized, communicates proactively, and does not wait to be told what to do when something is unclear or needs to be fixed.



You will be responsible for producing 100 static ad creatives per day, Monday through Friday, using assigned briefs, templates, hooks, offers, client assets, and creative direction.



We use Asana for project management and Slack for daily team communication.



What You’ll Do



In this role, you will create high-volume static ad creatives for
 and Instagram campaigns. Your work will be used for direct-response testing, so the goal is not just to make things look good. The goal is to create clean, readable, launch-ready ads that clearly communicate the hook, offer, and message.



You will be expected to:



•Create 100 static ad creatives per day.



•Design
 and Instagram static ads.



•Use AI tools to speed up creative production.



•Follow assigned creative briefs inside Asana.



•Create variations of hooks, headlines, offers, layouts, and visual concepts.



•Organize files by client, campaign, date, and angle.



•Communicate daily progress, blockers, and completed work in Slack.



•Make revisions quickly based on feedback.



•Maintain a high standard of usable, launch-ready creative.



•Work collaboratively with creative strategists, media buyers, and account managers.



•Pay attention to what is being tested and why, so creative output improves over time.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is fast, organized, creative, coachable, and comfortable with high-volume production.



You do not need to be the world’s fanciest designer. You do need to be reliable, detail-oriented, and able to create ads that are clear enough to test. You should understand that paid social creative needs to sell, not just look pretty.



You should have experience with:



Area

What We Expect

Design tools

Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools.



AI creative tools

ChatGPT, Midjourney, Higgsfield, OpenAI image tools, or similar.



Paid social creative

Experience creating
 and Instagram static ad creatives.



Direct-response design

Ability to create ads with clear hooks, strong hierarchy, readable text, and obvious offers.



Workflow tools

Comfortable working inside Asana and Slack.



High-volume production

Ability to produce many variations quickly without becoming disorganized.





Strong English communication is important because this role requires clear written updates, feedback loops, and daily coordination with the team.



Key Metrics



This role is measured by simple production and quality numbers. We care about speed, but we also care about accuracy, organization, and whether the creative is actually usable.





Daily production volume

100 statics per day

You are expected to produce 100 completed static ad creatives per workday, Monday through Friday.



Weekly output

500 statics per week

Your weekly production goal is 500 completed static ad creatives.



QA pass rate

90%+

At least 90% of submitted creatives should pass our internal QA scorecard.



QA includes things like correct offer, correct client or brand, correct dimensions, clear visual hierarchy, no spelling errors, proper file naming, organized folders, and whether the creative follows the assigned brief.



What We Care About Most



We want someone who takes ownership.



If something is unclear, you ask. If something breaks, you communicate. If a brief is missing something important, you flag it instead of guessing silently. If feedback is given, you apply it quickly and improve the next batch.



We move fast, expect high standards, and care deeply about client results. The right person for this role is calm under pressure, organized in their workflow, and able to keep producing without letting quality fall apart.



This role is a good fit for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable being measured by output. We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of the creative production system, not someone who needs constant reminders or hand-holding.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You



•Like fast-paced creative production.



•Are comfortable using AI tools.



•Can follow directions without needing constant reminders.



•Understand that ads need to sell, not just look pretty.



•Can create lots of variations quickly.



•Stay organized across clients, folders, files, and deadlines.



•Communicate clearly in Slack.



•Take feedback well and apply it quickly.



•Can consistently hit daily output goals.



•Stay calm under pressure.



•Take ownership when something is unclear, missing, or needs to be fixed.



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You

•Need several hours to make one design.



•Dislike AI tools.



•Struggle with organization.



•Do not like being measured by output.



•Disappear during work hours.



•Get defensive about feedback.



•Cannot consistently follow briefs.



•Need constant reminders to complete assigned work.



•Are uncomfortable with fast-paced agency-style work.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time role.





Schedule

Monday through Friday



Hours

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, New York City time



Location

Open to worldwide applicants



Communication

Strong written English required



Candidates must be available during the full working schedule and able to communicate clearly with the team throughout the day.



How To Apply



Please send:

description:
