We’re a fast-scaling DTC Shopify brand doing multiple six figures per month, on track for 8 figures in the next 12–18 months. We sell physical products globally and are in the middle of upgrading our factory, QC, and 3PL setup while preparing new product launches.



We move fast, run lean, and need a calm, competent operator who can own our supply chain end-to-end so the founders are not firefighting factories and logistics every day.



---The Mission---

Own the flow of product from factory to customer.

Right stock, right place, right time. No stockouts on key SKUs and no cash stuck in dead inventory.



You are the single point of truth between:

- Factories / suppliers

- Freight forwarders

- Our 3PL

- Our internal team

- When something breaks in the supply chain, you take ownership to fix it and prevent it from happening again.



In Your First 90 Days, Success Looks Like:

- We have a single, reliable inventory + PO tracker that founders can trust at a glance.

- No preventable stockouts on our hero product.

- All inbound POs are tracked with clear ETAs and updated weekly.

- Our 3PL SLAs are defined and monitored (receiving times, shipping times, error rates).

- Core supply chain SOPs are documented and followed.



---What You’ll Own---

- Daily communication with factories/suppliers: production timelines, samples, QC, shipping.

- Manage our 3PL relationship: inbound shipments, receiving, fulfillment, returns.

- Inventory planning and purchasing: forecast demand, calculate reorder points, place POs on time.

- Track inventory days-on-hand and highlight low stock (risk of stockout) or overstock (cash trap).

- Coordinate international freight, customs, and deliveries to 3PL.

- Maintain a clean, real-time stock + PO dashboard.

- Define QC standards and hold suppliers accountable.

- Build and document SOPs so operations do not live in your head.

- Flag risks early: delays, quality drops, lead-time changes, single-supplier issues.



---You’re a Fit If You Have---

- 2–3+ years in e?commerce operations / supply chain / logistics (DTC physical products ideal).

- Hands-on experience managing factories or suppliers (China/Asia experience is a strong plus).

- Experience working with 3PLs and managing inbound/outbound logistics.

- Strong inventory planning skills: reorder points, lead times, demand forecasting.

- Comfort with Shopify and inventory/ops tools.

- Excellent English and proactive written communication.

- You are calm, organized, and reliable under pressure.



---You’ll Excel Here If---

- You’re proactive and raise flags before delays become stockouts.

- You are relentless with follow-up; suppliers and 3PLs do not “slip” on your watch.

- You think in systems and love cleaning up messy processes.

- You want to grow into a Head of Operations role as we scale.

## QuickBooks Online | AR/AP | General Ledger | U.S. Payroll | Reporting | Reconciliations

This is not a basic bookkeeping role. We are looking for a highly experienced accounting professional who can help manage the full accounting operation, improve financial reporting, clean up processes, support integrations, and work directly with company leadership.



The right candidate should have strong experience working with U.S.-based companies, QuickBooks Online, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, general ledger, payroll, reconciliations, month-end close, financial reports, and accounting operations.



We need someone who can think like an accounting manager, not just enter transactions.



## Responsibilities



You will be responsible for supporting and improving our accounting operations, including:



* Managing Accounts Receivable and client invoicing

* Managing Accounts Payable and vendor bill tracking

* Reviewing vendor invoices and matching them to jobs, work orders, approvals, and supporting documents

* Reviewing chart of accounts and transaction classifications

* Assisting with month-end close

* Preparing cash flow, AR, AP, profitability, and expense reports

* Working with leadership on accounting cleanup and process improvement

* Helping with QuickBooks Online cleanup and maintenance

* Supporting system integrations between operations, work orders, invoices, vendor bills, and QuickBooks

* Identifying duplicate transactions, missing invoices, missing bills, incorrect coding, and reconciliation issues

* Creating accounting trackers, checklists, and SOPs

* Supporting leadership with reporting needed for decision-making



## Required Experience



Please do not apply unless you meet the majority of these requirements:



* Minimum 8 years of accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations experience

* Strong QuickBooks Online experience is required

* Experience working with U.S.-based companies is required

* Experience working with or reporting to a CFO, controller, finance director, or senior accounting leader

* Strong Accounts Receivable experience

* Strong Accounts Payable experience

* Strong general ledger experience

* Strong bank and credit card reconciliation experience

* Experience with U.S. payroll review, payroll reports, payroll liabilities, and payroll-related accounting entries

* Experience preparing financial reports for management

* Experience with month-end close

* Experience cleaning up messy books or improving accounting processes

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Strong written English

* Ability to work independently without being chased

* Ability to ask smart questions and flag issues before they become problems

* High attention to detail

* Comfortable working with U.S. Eastern Time overlap



## Preferred Experience



These are not required, but they are a strong advantage:



* Experience with construction, facility maintenance, property management, service companies, subcontractors, or project-based accounting

* Experience with job costing, customer/project tracking, class tracking, or department tracking in QuickBooks

* Experience with vendor management and subcontractor billing

* Experience with work orders, purchase orders, client portals, or service-based invoicing

* Experience identifying cash flow issues, margin issues, and accounting process gaps



## Type of Person We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Very organized

* Very detail-oriented

* Proactive

* Honest and reliable

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving company

* Able to handle complexity

* Able to create structure where the process is not perfect yet

* Able to communicate clearly when something is missing, wrong, delayed, or risky

* Able to protect the company from accounting mistakes, wrong payments, duplicate invoices, and missed billing



We do not want someone who only waits for instructions. We need someone who can review the situation, identify the problem, recommend the solution, and help build the process.



## Work Schedule



This is a full-time remote role.



You must be available for daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



## Compensation

Compensation will depend on experience, QuickBooks skill level, U.S. accounting experience, reporting ability, and ability to manage accounting operations independently.



## How to Apply

2. Your expected monthly salary in USD

4. A short summary of your Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable experience

5. A short summary of your general ledger and reconciliation experience

Please also answer the questions below:

title: UGC Video Editor - Ecommerce
description:
Fill out form: (ADD PORFOLIO IN FORM, NO PORTFOLIO = APPLICATION NOT ACCEPTED)






UGC EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

AGENCY EXPERIENCE PREFERRED



About Us

We're a company running 7–8 figure DTC brand portfolios operating across the US, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our growth runs through paid social - Meta and TikTok at a serious scale, which means video is at the center of everything we do. We produce a high volume of UGC-style and direct-response ad creative, and we need editors who can keep up without the output quality slipping.



This isn't a passion project or a content agency. The videos we edit run as paid ads, and the numbers tell us immediately what's working and what isn't. If you're the kind of editor who gets better with every round of feedback and wants to understand why something performs, not just how it looks, this is the environment for you.

We operate across multiple brands and categories, which means if needed, our editors must have the ability to switch between brand voices and audience types without losing quality or pace.

 

The Role

You'll be editing video content primarily for paid social - UGC ads, direct-response creatives, product-focused content, AI visuals generation, and repurposed organic clips across Meta and TikTok. You'll work from briefs and raw footage provided by our creative strategists and UGC creators, and you'll be expected to turn around polished, platform-ready ads at a reliable pace.

This is a high-output, high-feedback role. You'll be part of a structured creative production workflow, briefs, revisions, performance reviews and the feedback you get will be based on how the content actually performs, not just how it looks.

 

What You'll Be Doing

Core Editing

•    Editing UGC-style and direct-response video ads from raw footage – fast edits [minimum 1.5sec-2 seconds frame changes on visuals], aggressive visuals, clean cuts when needed, strong pacing, and hooks that don't lose the viewer in the first three seconds

•    Applying motion graphics, captions, text overlays, sound design, and music to produce platform-ready content across Meta and TikTok

•    Working from creative briefs and script references you follow the direction but you also bring your eye to it

•    Producing multiple versions of the same concept (hook tests, CTA variations, format cuts) efficiently

Workflow & Collaboration

•    Receiving and interpreting briefs from creative strategists - asking smart questions upfront rather than going back and forth after the first cut

•    Submitting first cuts on time and responding to revision notes quickly and accurately

•    Staying current on UGC trends, editing styles, and platform-native formats and flagging when you see something worth testing

•    Keeping your project files, exports, and asset folders organized according to team SOPs

•    Supporting the team in repurposing high-performing content into new formats when needed

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

•    A strong portfolio of edited video ads -  UGC, direct-response, or DTC brand content; we want to see cuts that are designed to perform, not just look good

•    Proficiency in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut - you can work fast in whichever tool the project calls for

•    Strong sense of pacing - you know when a cut is too slow, when a hook is burying itself, and when to trim

•    Understanding of how paid social video works: hook structure, attention retention, CTA placement, and format differences between Meta and TikTok

•    Reliable output - you can handle multiple concurrent edits and hit deadlines consistently

•    Receptive to feedback, revision rounds are part of the job; taking notes personally isn't

Strong Advantages

•    Experience editing DTC, beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brand content

•    Motion graphics skills , text animations, transitions, lower thirds that go beyond basic templates

•    Experience with AI-assisted editing tools that improve turnaround without sacrificing quality

•    Understanding of what makes a winning ad not just technically clean editing, but structurally effective storytelling

•    Familiarity with the UGC content model and how to make creator footage feel polished without losing authenticity

Instant No's

•    Your portfolio is full of cinematic, long-form, or brand film content with no paid social or direct-response work we're not doing that here

•    You need heavy direction on every edit

•    You treat revision notes as optional suggestions - revisions exist to make the content perform better, and accuracy matters

•    You can't sustain output at volume - this is a high-output environment and pace is part of the job

 

What the First 90 Days Look Like

First 30 Days

•    Complete onboarding: brand immersion, SOP walkthrough, file structure orientation, and creative review process

•    Shadow existing edit requests to understand the standard we hold our output to

•    Begin editing live briefs and establish reliable turnaround time and revision accuracy from day one

60 Days

•    Editing independently with minimal back-and-forth, at this time, you've internalized the brief format and the quality bar

•    Operating at full output capacity across concurrent projects

90 Days

•    A trusted, high-output editor the team doesn't need to micromanage

•    Actively contributing to creative iteration and not just executing briefs but improving them

•    Clear track record of on-time delivery, accurate revisions, and consistent quality

•    Positioned for growth toward a Senior Editor role as the team scales

 

How We Measure Your Performance

•    Output volume - number of completed edits per week against targets

•    Revision rate - how many rounds does it take to get to final approval

•    Turnaround time - from brief receipt to first cut submission

•    Creative contribution - are you bringing ideas, flagging trends, and improving the briefs you receive

•    Ad performance - over time, do the edits you produce correlate with stronger results and are you getting winning ads

 

Compensation & Benefits

•    Competitive monthly rate (contractor) based on experience and portfolio quality

•    Clear growth path: Video Editor ? Senior Video Editor

•    Fully remote - no fixed location, flexible setup

•    Learning & development budget

•    Access to winning ad references and a structured feedback system that actually makes you better

•    Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production at real scale

•    Weekly performance reviews with the Creative Director

 

???? We produce a lot of content and we move fast. If you thrive in a structured creative environment where your work gets tested against real numbers and you want to get genuinely better at your craft this is a strong place to be.



Hiring Process

1. Fill out form: (ADD PORFOLIO IN FORM, NO PORTFOLIO = APPLICATION NOT ACCEPTED)


2. Once screened, you'll do skills assessment test

3. Interview

ta ads on

We are looking for a part-time video editor and AI ad creative creator who can help us create, adapt and test high-performing ad creatives.



The main focus of this role is video editing. The image ad creation part is mostly done with AI tools, so for that part we mainly need someone who can follow instructions carefully, understand marketing angles, recognise strong visuals and prepare creatives for testing.



Before applying, please read the 4R model for this role here:



4R model: 



This document explains the role, responsibilities, requirements and expected results in more detail.



What you will be doing



Your main responsibility will be creating and editing video ads for
 and Instagram.



You will:



• Edit short-form video ads for Meta campaigns

• Translate or adapt existing video ads for different countries and languages

• Create variations of existing winning video ads

• Adapt video ads for different products, countries and angles

• Add captions, hooks, transitions, product shots and call-to-action sections

• Follow direct-response ad structures and creative testing instructions

• Work from clear creative briefs when creating new ads

• Improve creatives based on feedback

• Prepare finished videos in the correct format for Meta campaigns



Next to video editing, you will also help with AI image and AI video creative production.



For AI creatives, you will:



• Use AI prompts and instructions that we provide

• Generate AI-assisted visuals and video content

• Take existing image ads and adapt them for specific countries

• Adjust proven image ads for new but similar products

• Create variations of winning image ads

• Analyse AI-generated images and select the strongest options

• Improve visuals using AI tools

• Prepare image creatives so they are ready for testing



How we work



We are an eCommerce business using:



• Funnel-based selling

• Direct-response marketing

• Meta ads as our main traffic source

• Continuous creative testing

• Fast product launches

• Structured workflows and clear instructions



You will not be expected to invent everything from scratch.



In some cases, your task will be simple. For example, you may only need to translate or adapt an existing video ad for another country, language or product.



In other cases, you will follow a detailed creative brief. This brief will explain the product, the angle, the target audience, the hook, the structure and the type of visuals we need.



At the start, the focus will be on following our instructions, examples and briefs as closely as possible. Once you have proven that you understand our style, our audience and our creative testing process, there will also be room for your own ideas, input and creative suggestions.



Tools we provide



We provide access to the tools needed to create, edit and improve ad creatives.



For video editing, we can provide access to 
.



For AI video and image creation, we provide access to advanced tools such as Magnific and Higgsfield on the highest available plan.



Depending on the task, you may be asked to:



• Translate or adapt an existing video ad

• Edit a video based on a clear creative brief

• Create new AI-assisted video visuals

• Improve AI-generated visuals

• Prepare video ads for different countries, products or angles

• Create image ad variations using our AI systems



What we are looking for



We are looking for someone who is strong in video editing and has a good eye for marketing.



You should be:



• Experienced with editing short-form video ads

• Comfortable creating
 and Instagram ad creatives

• Able to follow clear instructions and structured workflows

• Able to create multiple variations of one winning concept

• Good at understanding hooks, pacing, captions and visual flow

• Comfortable working with AI image and video tools, or willing to learn quickly

• Able to recognise what looks believable, emotional and interesting

• Organised, reliable and deadline-focused

• Open to feedback and able to improve quickly



Important



This is not only a “make it look nice” role.



We need someone who understands that ads are made to sell.



You do not need to be a professional graphic designer for the image ad part, because most images are created with AI. However, you do need to have a good sense of what looks clear, believable, emotional and suitable for a 45+ audience.



For video editing, experience is much more important. We need someone who can create clean, engaging and direct-response style video ads that are ready to be tested on Meta.



We are looking for someone who can follow instructions very well in the beginning. You do not need to come up with every idea yourself from day one. We will provide briefs, examples, prompts, structures and access to the tools needed to create the ads.



However, once you have proven that you can follow the system, understand our products and deliver strong creatives, we are open to giving you more freedom to bring your own input and creative ideas.



Bonus points

• Experience with health and beauty products

• Experience with Meta ads

• Experience editing UGC-style videos

title: Claude Code / AI Automation Setup Specialist – Cebu City Preferred
description:
We are looking for a technical person in Cebu City or nearby who can help us set up Claude Code and AI automation systems for our business.



This is not a normal VA role. We need someone who is comfortable following technical setup instructions, using terminals, connecting tools, testing automations, and troubleshooting when something does not work the first time.



You do not need to be a senior developer, but you must be technical, patient, detail-oriented, and willing to figure things out.



The main goal of this role is simple:



Help us set up working Claude Code automations and document the setup clearly so the process can be repeated later.



You will be helping with things like:



Setting up Claude Code on a computer

Running commands in terminal

Connecting APIs, webhooks, Google Sheets, CRMs,
 tools, and automation platforms

Following detailed SOPs step by step

Testing automations to make sure they work properly

Troubleshooting setup errors by Googling, reading docs, and trying fixes

Recording what was done so another person can repeat it

Turning messy technical steps into clear setup notes



Tools you may work with:



Claude Code, ChatGPT, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, Make/Zapier-style automation tools, APIs, webhooks, browser tools, code editors, terminals,
 tools, and CRMs.



You do not need to already know every tool. What matters most is that you can learn quickly, follow instructions carefully, and solve setup problems without needing constant hand-holding.



This role is a good fit for someone who:



Is naturally technical

Has used terminals, code editors, APIs, GitHub, webhooks, or automation tools before

Can follow a detailed setup guide without skipping steps

Can troubleshoot errors independently before asking for help

Can explain what they did in simple language

Is comfortable with technical dashboards, settings pages, and documentation

Is available to meet in Cebu City if needed for initial setup/onboarding



This role is not a good fit if:



You only want basic VA/data entry work

You are not comfortable using technical tools

You give up quickly when an error appears

You skip steps or do not document your work

You need every small instruction repeated multiple times



Work setup:



Cebu City preferred. Remote is okay for the right person, but being able to meet in person for initial onboarding is a big advantage.



This will start with a paid test project. If the test goes well, this can become an ongoing role.



Compensation:



Starting at 30,000–40,000 PHP/month depending on skill level and results. Higher pay is possible if you can independently set up and troubleshoot automation systems.



40 hours/week preferred, but we can start with a paid test project first.



To apply, answer these carefully. Generic or AI-looking answers will be skipped.



1. Tell me about one technical setup you personally completed. Do not describe your general skills. Pick one real setup and explain:

- What tool/software you set up

- What the goal was

- What broke during setup

- What you tried first

- What finally fixed it

- How you proved it was working



2. Imagine I give you access to a laptop and ask you to set up Claude Code from scratch. What would you check before you begin? Give me your actual checklist.



3. You are following an SOP and step 14 does not work because the terminal shows an error. What exactly do you do in the next 20 minutes before asking me for help?



4. Explain these in simple words:

- API

- Webhook

- Terminal command

- Environment variable

- GitHub repository

- Automation workflow



5. Give an example of a time you connected two tools together. What were the two tools, what data moved between them, and how did you confirm it worked?



6. When documenting a technical setup for someone else, what screenshots or notes would you include so they can repeat it without you?



7. You are setting up an automation and it works once, but fails the second time. What are the first things you would check?



8. What is one technical thing you do not know yet, but you are confident you could figure out? Explain how you would learn it.



9. Small thinking test:

Imagine I give you a Google Sheet with customer names,
s, and statuses. I want Claude Code or another automation tool to check the sheet every day, find rows marked “Ready,” create a draft
 for each one, and update the row to “Draft Created.”



Explain:

- What tools you would use

- What access you would need

- What steps you would take first

- How you would test it safely

- What could go wrong

- How you would document it after it works



10. Record a 2–3 minute Loom video explaining any technical setup, automation, tool, or workflow you have used before. It does not need to be advanced. I want to see how clearly you explain steps.



At the top of your application, write:

“I can troubleshoot before escalating.”

title: Short form Video Editor
description:
We are hiring a full-time short-form video editor who lives and breathes the Devin Jatho editing style — fast-paced talking-head edits with high-retention captions, kinetic typography, smooth zooms, motion graphics, and After Effects-driven visual storytelling.



The role splits across two equally important pillars:



Paid ad creatives — Meta, TikTok, and YouTube short-form ads that hook in the first 1.5 seconds, hold attention, and convert.

Organic client content — the videos we shoot in-person for our clients (talking heads, behind-the-scenes, product showcases, branded short-form) edited into polished Reels, TikToks, and Shorts.



You'll be cutting both, so you need to understand what makes content stop the scroll and what makes an ad sell. This is not a captions-only job. If your "Devin Jatho style" stops at animated subtitles, this role isn't for you. We need someone who treats every second of a Reel or ad like a piece of visual choreography — overlays timed to sound design, B-roll cut to the beat, motion graphics that earn attention, and the taste to know when less is more.

Who We Are:

Aspire Media Productions is a content-led marketing agency based in New York, serving local service businesses, healthcare practices, law firms, and the auto aftermarket industry. We shoot premium content for our clients in-person and run paid ad campaigns to scale their results. You'll be editing across multiple niches — one day it's a Lamborghini detail shop, the next it's a wellness clinic — so adaptability matters.



What You'll Be Doing:



Editing paid ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube — hook-driven, retention-engineered, conversion-focused short-form videos

Editing organic client content from in-person shoots — 15–60 second talking-head Reels, TikToks, and Shorts in the Devin Jatho aesthetic

Producing multiple ad variations per concept (different hooks, CTAs, pacing tests)

Building animated captions with rhythm, color emphasis, and pacing that drives retention

Creating motion graphics, kinetic text reveals, and AE-based visual elements

Layering in B-roll, PNGs, emojis, sound design, and SFX with intention

Color grading talking-head footage to a clean, premium look

Owning revisions and turnaround times — you ship work that's near-final on the first pass



Required Skills:



Mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro AND After Effects (non-negotiable — AE is half the job)

Strong understanding of direct-response ad creative principles — hooks, pattern interrupts, retention curves, CTAs

Ability to edit organic content that feels native to the platform, not "ad-like"

Sound design instincts (you know when to add an SFX and when to let silence hit)

High-level typography taste — captions that enhance the talking head, not distract from it

Color grading fundamentals

Ability to match a brand style guide and edit consistently across clients



Speed: comfortable producing 3–5 polished short-form edits per week minimum, plus ad variations



Bonus Points:



Direct experience editing paid Meta or TikTok ads with documented performance (CTR, ROAS, hook rate)

Experience editing for personal brands, agencies, or content creators in the SMMA / marketing space


 / Google Drive workflow experience

Basic Photoshop or Illustrator skills for asset creation

Long-term position — we want someone we can grow with for years, not a 3-month gig

Showcase stunning 4K nature and wildlife footage while creating a relaxing viewing experience for the audience.



I'm looking for someone who enjoys this type of content and is interested in building a long-term working relationship.



???? What You'll Be Creating



The channel will focus mainly on:



Wildlife and animals in 4K

Nature and landscapes in 4K

Relaxing ambient videos

Calm, immersive content with relaxing background music



The videos are not fast-paced and do not require flashy effects, animations, motion graphics, voiceovers, or subtitles.



Instead, the focus is on:



Beautiful footage

Smooth pacing

Relaxing atmosphere

High visual quality

Immersive viewing experiences



I will provide access to premium stock footage and music platforms such as Envato Elements and Artlist.



???? Example Videos



The videos we create should have a similar style, pacing, and atmosphere to examples like these:























Please review these examples before applying so you understand the type of content and editing style I'm looking for.



???? Workload



To start, I will need:



4 videos per month (1 video per week)



Each video should be between:



1 and 2 hours long



Ideally, most videos will be around 2 hours long.



However, if a specific topic does not have enough high-quality stock footage available, shorter videos are perfectly acceptable.



Quality is much more important than forcing every video to reach a specific length.



If the videos look great and perform well, there will be opportunities to increase production to up to 8 videos per month in the future.



? What I'm Looking For



The two most important things for this channel are:



1. Exceptional Visual Quality



The videos should feel premium and showcase the beauty of nature and wildlife in the best possible way.



I'm looking for an editor who can:



Select stunning 4K footage

Maintain high visual quality throughout the video

Create a natural flow between scenes

Avoid repetitive or low-quality clips

Pay attention to composition, color, and overall aesthetics

Create videos that viewers enjoy watching for long periods of time



2. A Relaxing Viewing Experience



These videos are designed to help people relax.



The editing should feel:



Calm

Natural

Smooth

Immersive

Peaceful



The goal is not fast-paced editing or complicated effects.



What matters most is your ability to combine beautiful footage with relaxing music and create an enjoyable viewing experience.



????? Requirements



Editing Software



DaVinci Resolve is strongly preferred.



Computer



Because you'll be working with large amounts of 4K footage, you'll need a computer that can comfortably:



Edit long 4K videos

Handle large project files

Export 4K videos efficiently



Internet Connection



A fast and reliable internet connection is essential.



You'll regularly download large 4K footage files from stock footage websites, so please only apply if your connection can comfortably handle large downloads.



Bonus Qualifications



The following are a plus:



Experience editing long-form YouTube content

Experience creating relaxation, ambient, nature, or wildlife videos

Experience working with stock footage libraries

Experience sourcing and organizing footage from platforms such as Envato Elements and Artlist



???? Compensation



Base Pay



€1.25 per finished minute



Examples:



60-minute video = €75

90-minute video = €112.50

100-minute video = €
minute video = €150

Performance Bonuses (Cumulative)



I also reward editors when videos perform well.



Bonuses are cumulative:



100,000 views = +€25

250,000 views = +€50

500,000 views = +€100

1,000,000 views = +€200



For example:



A 100-minute video would earn €125 in base pay.



If that video reaches 1 million views, the total bonus would be €375 (€25 + €50 + €100 + €200), bringing total compensation for that video to €500.



The maximum performance bonus per video is €375 (earned at 1 million views).



I believe that when the channel succeeds, the people helping build it should share in that success.



???? How to Apply



Please send:



Links to your best editing work

Your computer specifications

Your internet speed (download and upload)

Which editing software you use

A short introduction about yourself



To show that you've read the full job post, please start your application with:



WILDLIFE4K



Applications that do not include this keyword may not be considered.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer — Automation & DevOps
description:
--- About Authority Solutions® ---



Authority Solutions® is a digital marketing agency specializing in Web Design, SEO (Search Engine Optimization), and AI-powered marketing technology that grows revenue for our clients. Founded in 2014, we've grown year over year and have worked with remote tea
mbers in the Philippines since day one — they are core to who we are, not a side experiment.



We serve clients in the Medical, Legal, Ecommerce, and Home Services verticals, and we build our own technology to power how we deliver. We are a cutting-edge agency at the front edge of SEO and AI implementation, and we plan to grow aggressively over the next 12 months. This role is central to making that happen.



We are not a typical agency. We build our own tools. We use AI assistants and automation agents every day. We ship fast, iterate constantly, and expect every person on the team to own what they build. If you want a long-term home on a small, high-output team where your work directly drives the company forward — keep reading.





Why this role is different



Most agencies will hand you a ticket queue and a template to edit. We're handing you the keys.



You'll architect and build real software from a blank page, stand up the infrastructure it runs on, and wire together the systems that keep the business moving. You'll work directly with company leadership — not three layers of management — to understand the problem, then go solve it.



And here's the part that matters most for your career: you'll be building with the best AI development tooling available. Many talented engineers never get hands-on access to top-tier AI coding assistants and automation platforms. We use them daily, we pay for the good ones, and we'll put them in your hands on day one. If you're hungry to level up fast, this is where you do it — you'll leave this role a dramatically stronger engineer than you arrived.



This is not a side gig. We're hiring one person for the long haul — someone who wants to grow with us, take on more responsibility and compensation over time, and treat what they build as their own. If you're collecting short contracts on the side, this isn't the right fit, and that's okay. If you're looking for a place to plant roots and build a career, read on.





What you'll actually do



This is a hands-on, high-ownership role across three connected areas:



1. Build full-stack web applications from scratch. Design and ship production web apps end to end — database schema, API layer, frontend UI, authentication, and deployment. These are greenfield builds, not maintenance of someone else's code. You own the product from concept to live, then iterate based on how the team actually uses it.



2. Own the infrastructure and DevOps. Stand up environments, manage deployments across dev/staging/production, handle environment configuration and secrets properly, and keep what you ship observable, reliable, and recoverable. You're comfortable deploying and managing web properties programmatically and at scale, and you understand how to integrate a stack of external APIs into one coherent system.



3. Engineer business-critical automations. Design, build, and maintain multi-step automation workflows that move data reliably between platforms — CRMs, ecommerce systems, project management tools, communication channels, and spreadsheets. You build the plumbing so that data, events, and alerts flow correctly, with error handling that doesn't fail silently.



You will not be waiting for tickets. You'll be working with leadership to understand what needs to exist, then building it.





Who you are





You're a builder. You get energy from shipping things, not fro
etings about shipping things.

You have integrity and you finish what you start. When you say it's done, it's done. When something breaks, you raise your hand early instead of hiding it.

You want a long-term home. You're looking to grow with one company over years, not stack short-term gigs.

You're comfortable with ambiguity. "Here's the problem — figure out the best solution" excites you rather than stresses you.

You context-switch well. You can write a React component in the morning and debug a webhook integration or a deployment issue in the afternoon.

You're a self-starter. You research, troubleshoot, and find answers independently before escalating. Documentation, search, and AI tools are your first line of defense.

You document and communicate. You write things down so others can maintain them, and you proactively share status — especially when something is blocked, broken, or behind.







--- Required technical skills ---



Full-Stack Development



React / Next.js — Building production web applications from scratch (not just editing templates).

TypeScript / JavaScript — Strong fundamentals, not copy-paste from search results.

Backend & databases (SQL/Postgres) — Schema design, relationships, indexing, and writing efficient queries. Experience with a modern backend-as-a-service platform (e.g., Supabase or Firebase) including auth, row-level security, and serverless functions is a strong plus.

REST APIs — Designing and consuming APIs, authentication patterns, pagination, and robust error handling. You should be comfortable integrating many third-party APIs into one system.

Tailwind CSS / responsive UI — Clean, responsive interfaces that work across screen sizes.





DevOps & Infrastructure



Deployment & environments — Confidently take an app from your machine to production: build step, environment configuration, deploy target, verification, and a rollback plan.

Environment variables & secrets — You never hardcode keys or commit secrets; you understand per-environment config.

Containers — Working understanding of Docker and why consistent environments matter ("works on my machine" is a problem you know how to eliminate).

Hosting platforms — Experience deploying and managing apps and web properties on modern platforms (e.g., Vercel, Render, Railway, or similar).

Git — Version-control discipline: feature branches, small meaningful commits, pull requests, not pushing straight to main.





Automation & Integration Engineering





Workflow automation (n8n or equivalent) — Multi-step workflows including webhooks, scheduled jobs, branching logic, data transformation, retries, idempotency, and error handling. (n8n, Make, Zapier, or custom code — what matters is you understand the patterns.)

Integrating SaaS platforms — Comfort connecting tools such as CRMs, ecommerce systems, project management, chat/messaging, and spreadsheets via their APIs and webhooks. You'll learn our specific stack quickly; the underlying skill is what we're hiring for.

Data integrity — Deduplication, reconciliation, audit logging, and handling edge cases and out-of-order events so the same thing never gets processed twice.





AI-Assisted Development





Baseline familiarity required — You've used AI coding assistants (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot) and understand how to prompt them, validate their output, and use them to ship faster without losing track of what you're actually building.

Eagerness to go deep — You don't need elite-tier access today. We provide it, and we expect you to grow into power-user proficiency fast. Ability to evaluate and prototype AI-powered features is something you'll develop here with the best tools in the industry at your fingertips.







--- Nice-to-have (not required) ---



Experience deploying and managing large numbers of web properties or landing pages programmatically.

Familiarity with search-infrastructure concepts: indexing, sitemaps, structured data/schema, and how content gets discovered and ranked.

Building chatbots or conversational AI agents.

WordPress custom API integrations or plugin development.

Stripe or other payment-processing integrations.

Familiarity with SEO tools and marketing-technology platforms.

Experience modeling API costs at scale.







--- What success looks like ---



First 30 days



Onboarded to our systems and toolchain, including AI development tools.

Shipped at least one small tool or meaningful feature.

Taken ownership of and stabilized existing automation workflows.

Established a clear communication rhythm with leadership.





First 90 days



Your first full-stack application is in production and being used by the team.

Critical automations are documented, monitored, and running reliably.

You're proactively identifying and proposing improvements, not just executing.

You're operating independently on day-to-day priorities.





First 6 months



Multiple tools shipped and iterating based on real usage.

Infrastructure is reliable, observable, and well-documented.

You've become the team's go-to for "how should we build this?"

Your work has produced measurable time savings and operational improvements — and you're being trusted with bigger problems.







--- Core responsibilities ---



Application development



Build web applications (frontend + API + database + auth) from concept to production.

Own the full lifecycle: schema design, API development, UI, deployment, and ongoing iteration.

Write clean, maintainable, documented code. Ship working prototypes first, then polish based on feedback.





DevOps & reliability



Manage deployment across dev, staging, and production with verification and rollback.

Configure environments and manage secrets securely.

Keep systems observable — logging, status visibility, and alerting so problems surface fast.





Automation & integration



Design and deploy multi-step automation workflows that synchronize data across business platforms.

Implement robust error handling: retries, deduplication, dead-letter patterns, audit logging, and alerts on failure.

Establish reusable patterns with consistent naming, standardized building blocks, and clean environment-variable management.





Documentation & visibility



Document workflows, system architecture, and runbooks.

Build operational dashboards and status outputs so the team can see what's running.

Maintain mapping and integration documentation as systems grow.





Continuous improvement



Evaluate and recommend tools and processes that make the team faster.

Prototype new automation and AI-powered capabilities.







--- Soft skills that matter here ---



Self-directed problem solver — You exhaust documentation, search, and AI tools before escalating.

Time management — You show up on time, hit deadlines, and flag slippage early.

Strong written communication — You explain technical decisions clearly and write documentation others can follow.

Ownership mentality — If you built it, you own it. Bugs, performance, uptime — yours until it's handed off.







--- Work schedule & holidays ---



All staff work a split shift so we can collaborate and meet with US leadership on pertinent tasks.

We observe all US holidays as well as PH public holidays (New Year's Day, Lunar New Year, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, Bataan Day, Labour Day, Philippine Independence Day, National Heroes' Day, Bonifacio Day, Feast of the Immaculate Conception, Christmas Day, Rizal Day). We work hard and we value time with family.

After a 90-day probationary period, all staff qualify for leave with proper notice per the employee handbook.







--- Compensation ---



Full-time, long-term position (this is a career role, not a contract gig).

Typical monthly earnings of roughly $1,700–$2,100 USD for this role, depending on demonstrated knowledge, technical ability, and experience — with room to earn more as you take on greater responsibility.

Performance-based increases as your scope and impact grow. We promote and pay from within as the company scales.







--- Perks & benefits ---



Elite AI development tooling, paid for by us — top-tier AI coding assistants and automation platforms most engineers never get to use. This is how you grow your skill set fastest.

Paid access to the development platforms and API subscriptions you'll build on.

Paid training and courses for professional development.

Direct access to company leadership — your ideas get heard and shipped fast.

The chance to architect and build products from the ground up, not maintain someone else's code.

A small team where your contributions are visible and valued.

A clear path to increased responsibility and compensation as we grow.







--- How to apply ---



Do not send a generic application. We will ignore it. We're looking for one person to grow with us long-term, and how you apply tells us a lot about how you work.



Please include:



A brief introduction (video recording) — Who you are, what you've built recently, and why a long-term role here interests you.

A link to your portfolio, GitHub, or shipped work — We want to see things you've actually built and deployed, not tutorial projects.

Your experience with AI-assisted development — Which tools you've used, how they fit into your workflow, and one specific example of how they helped you ship faster or better. (No elite-tier access yet? Tell us how you'd use it if you had it.)



One question about the role — This tells us you actually read the posting.





Applications that follow these instructions will be reviewed first.

title: Solar Marketing & Sales Operations Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a Solar Marketing & Sales Operations Coordinator to help support our marketing, lead generation, appointment setting, sales support, and back-of-house process.



This role is designed to support the current management team and help keep the full process organised as the business continues to grow.



This is not just an advertising role. We need someone who understands how solar leads move through the full process — from enquiry, booking, sales handover, customer follow-up, paperwork, pre-inspection support, reporting, and the full back-of-house flow after a sale is made.



## Key Responsibilities



* Help coordinate the daily flow of solar leads from enquiry to appointment and sales handover

* Support marketing, appointment setters, sales staff, and admin support

* Understand and help coordinate the back-of-house flow, including paperwork, job details, pre-inspection information, customer updates, and handover to operations

* Track lead quality, appointment rates, follow-up, and sales results

* Help coordinate campaigns, landing pages, ads, and customer messaging

* Make sure leads are followed up properly and nothing is missed

* Support customer communication before and after the sale

* Help keep a small remote team organised and on track

* Provide basic daily and weekly reporting



## Skills Required



* Experience in marketing, lead generation, sales support, operations, or back-of-house coordination

* Solar industry experience highly regarded

* Strong understanding of how leads, sales, admin, pre-inspection, and operations connect

* Able to support and coordinate a small team

* Strong communication and follow-up skills

* Organised, practical, and reliable

* Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets,
 leads, and reporting tools

* Able to help connect marketing, sales, and operations into one clear process



## About the Role



This role would suit someone who understands that good marketing is not just about getting leads. It is about making sure the leads are contacted, booked, followed up, handed over properly, and tracked from start to finish.



We also need someone who understands the importance of the back-of-house process after a sale is made, including paperwork, job information, customer updates, pre-inspection details, and making sure the job flows properly into operations.



This is a remote role for the right person.



The solar industry can move quickly, and this role may require flexibility with hours and days depending on lead flow, sales activity, customer follow-up, and team requirements. This position would suit someone who is comfortable working in a growing business environment and is not looking for a strict 9 to 5 role only.



Please send your resume and a short message outlining your experience in marketing, lead generation, team support, back-of-house process, and solar if applicable.



When applying, please also include your expected hourly rate or weekly amount. Pay will depend on experience, solar knowledge, and suitability for the role. There will also be performance-based monthly bonuses linked to overall team growth and sales results.



Please read the job description properly before applying. Generic messages or standard copy-and-paste cover letters will not be considered. I want to hear how you believe you can support this role, how your experience matches what is needed, and how you would approach the position if successful.

title: Healthcare Compliance & Regulatory Advisor
description:
About the Opportunity



We are seeking a licensed attorney with experience in healthcare compliance, regulatory, legal, ethics, privacy, or risk management to support multinational organizations operating throughout the Asia-Pacific region.



This role offers the opportunity to work directly with executive leadership teams and senior advisors on complex compliance, governance, regulatory, privacy, anti-corruption, and risk management matters affecting multiple jurisdictions.



Particular emphasis will be placed on supporting organizations operating within the medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, and other highly regulated industries.



The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor supporting the development, implementation, enhancement, and ongoing operation of sophisticated compliance programs, regulatory initiatives, investigations, governance activities, and operational compliance functions throughout the APAC region.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Compliance Program Leadership & Governance

* Support the design, implementation, enhancement, and maintenance of enterprise compliance and ethics programs.

* Assist organizations with developing scalable compliance infrastructures, governance frameworks, reporting mechanisms, and oversight processes.

* Support compliance committee activities, executive reporting, risk management initiatives, and program effectiveness evaluations.

* Provide strategic and practical compliance guidance to executive leadership teams.

* Assist organizations in fostering a culture of ethics, compliance, accountability, and regulatory excellence.



Regulatory & Compliance Advisory

* Conduct legal, regulatory, and compliance research across APAC jurisdictions.

* Monitor regulatory developments, enforcement trends, industry standards, and emerging compliance risks.

* Prepare executive-level memoranda, reports, risk assessments, and compliance guidance.

* Analyze regulatory obligations and provide recommendations regarding implementation priorities and risk mitigation strategies.



Healthcare, Commercial & Third-Party Compliance

* Support reviews involving healthcare professional interactions, educational programs, sponsorships, grants, consultant engagements, speaker programs, and related activities.

* Assist with anti-bribery, anti-corruption, ethics, and third-party risk management initiatives.

* Support distributor, vendor, consultant, and business partner due diligence reviews.

* Assist with commercialization governance, promotional activities, and operational compliance matters.

* Provide guidance regarding industry expectations and healthcare compliance best practices.



Policies, Procedures & Training

* Draft, review, and maintain policies, procedures, codes of conduct, governance frameworks, standards, and guidance documents.

* Develop compliance training materials, communications, awareness initiatives, and educational programs.

* Support organization-wide compliance and ethics training initiatives involving anti-corruption, privacy, investigations, healthcare compliance, and related risk areas.

* Assist with policy implementation and operationalization efforts across multiple jurisdictions.



Investigations, Monitoring & Risk Assessments

* Conduct or support workplace investigations, compliance investigations, ethics matters, and issue management activities.

* Assist with witness interviews, documentation reviews, findings reports, and remediation planning.

* Conduct compliance risk assessments, monitoring activities, internal reviews, and gap analyses.

* Support development of risk-based auditing and monitoring programs designed to evaluate compliance program effectiveness.



Privacy, Data Protection & Regulatory Affairs

* Support privacy and data protection initiatives across multiple jurisdictions.

* Assist with cross-border data governance, vendor oversight, and regulatory compliance activities.

* Support organizations in preparing for regulatory inquiries, audits, inspections, and examinations.

* Interface with regulators, government agencies, accrediting organizations, and external stakeholders as needed.

* Coordinate with local counsel and subject matter experts regarding jurisdiction-specific legal and regulatory matters.



Preferred Qualifications

* Attorney, compliance professional, regulatory affairs professional, privacy professional, risk management professional, or related discipline.

* Minimum five years of relevant experience.

* Experience supporting multinational organizations operating across multiple APAC jurisdictions.

* Strong analytical, research, writing, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent verbal and written English proficiency.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively supporting executive leadership teams.

* Experience within healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, life sciences, financial services, or other regulated industries strongly preferred.



Location

Candidates located in Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Philippines, Thailand, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Vietnam, South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, New Zealand, or other APAC jurisdictions are encouraged to apply.



Work Arrangement

* Flexible consulting arrangement.

* Approximately 10 to 20 hours per week initially.

* Opportunity for long-term engagement and expanded responsibilities.

* Exposure to multinational organizations and complex regulatory environments.

* Potential involvement in global compliance, privacy, governance, and regulatory initiatives.



Application Requirements

Please submit the following to 



* Resume / Curriculum Vitae

* LinkedIn Profile, if available

* Brief Summary of Relevant Experience

* Desired Monthly Compensation

* Weekly Availability

* Earliest Available Start Date

title: Customer Service & Automotive Parts Call Specialist – Headlights
description:
We are an automotive lighting company selling OEM/recycled headlights to body shops, collision centers, insurance-related buyers, and repair facilities across the United States.



We are looking for a serious, sharp, professional customer service specialist who can handle calls,
s, order updates, tracking requests, returns, and basic headlight availability questions.



This job is NOT for beginners. You must be comfortable speaking with American customers on the phone.



Main Responsibilities:

 • Answer incoming customer calls professionally.

 • Speak with body shops, insurance-related buyers, and repair facilities.

 • Check if a specific headlight is available using part numbers, stock numbers, or vehicle information.

 • Ask customers for the correct information:
, phone number, shipping address, VIN, part number, photos, RO/PO number, and any details needed to confirm fitment.

 • Provide tracking numbers and delivery updates to customers.

 • Help customers with return requests.

 • Send return instructions and return
s using our company templates.

 • Communicate clearly with our billing/invoice employee.

 • Follow up with customers who need invoices, tracking, return help, or order updates.

 • Keep notes organized and make sure nothing is missed.

 • Handle calls calmly, professionally, and with confidence.



Required Skills:

 • Perfect or near-perfect American English accent.

 • Strong phone communication skills.

 • Must sound professional, confident, and clear.

 • Must be a car enthusiast or have strong automotive knowledge.

 • Must understand basic car parts, headlights, vehicle models, part numbers, and fitment.

 • Must be comfortable learning automotive systems and checking inventory.

 • Must be organized and detail-oriented.

 • Must be fast, reliable, and able to follow instructions exactly.

 • Must have good internet, a quiet work environment, and a reliable computer.



Very Important:

If you do not have a strong American accent, please do not apply.

If you are not interested in cars or automotive parts, please do not apply.

If you are not comfortable taking phone calls all day, please do not apply.



We need someone who can eventually handle most of the customer communication work that the owner currently handles.

title: Property Manager with Finance Experience (Community Finance Manager)
description:
The Community Finance Manager (CFM) is responsible for managing the financial operations of a portfolio of community associations. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, supports property managers and boards, and maintains strong client relationships while ensuring compliance with financial policies and regulations. 



Responsibilities: 

Financial Management & Reporting 

- Review monthly financial reports to ensure accuracy and completeness. 

- Analyze general ledgers, balance sheets, and income statements to identify discrepancies or required corrections. 

- Review banking and investment activities for assigned properties. 

- Provide recommendations and financial insights to improve reporting accuracy. 



Portfolio Financial Oversight 

- Manage financial records for multiple client associations (portfolio management). 

- Ensure financial data accurately reflects the association’s position. 

- Support audits and verify documentation for compliance. 



Client & Stakeholder Management 

- Serve as the primary financial partner to property managers and Board representatives. 

- Build and maintain strong relationships with Board Treasurers and stakeholders. 

- Respond to internal and client inquiries related to financial matters. 



Compliance & Administrative Oversight 

- Ensure compliance with financial policies, tax requirements, and regulatory filings. 

- Oversee administrative financial tasks such as tax payments, year-end filings, and government submissions. 



Collaboration & Continuous Improvement 

- Provide feedback to property managers on financial performance and reporting improvements. 

- Participate in tea
etings, set goals, and complete tasks within deadlines. 

- Work closely with finance and operations teams to resolve issues and improve processes. 



Skills & Qualifications: 

- Strong organizational skills and excellent work ethics. 

- Must be a team player and able to multitask. 

- Must have a basic understanding of balance sheets, P&L statements, reading an invoice, and understanding vendor statements. 

- Proficiency using Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Teams) 

- Prior experience using an accounting software (QuickBooks, Yardi, AF). 

- Ability to thoroughly explain issues, errors, and resolutions. 



Preferred Qualifications: 

- Prior experience in property management. 

- Cinc experience as PMS. 

- Timely, RingCentral and 
 experience. 



Working conditions: 

- Full remote work (work anywhere)

- Work schedule is Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST) including the 30 minutes unpaid meal break. 

- Acceptance of using a time-tracking device (Hubstaff) installed on your computer while rendering service with The Company



Physical requirements: 

- Must have a personal computer/laptop that will be exclusively used while rendering service with The Company

- Must have a back device (back up computer, back up internet, back up electricity) in case of service utility disruption

- Must have a conducive working area away from noise and any disturbances that will affect your service with The Company

title: SEO & Website Optimization Specialist
description:
Work with the Content Manager, CEO and the growing marketing team at Adventure Life to implement SEO and AIO strategy on the Adventure Life website and monitor performance to assess these efforts.



Major Duties and Responsibilities:



- Maintain and monitor SEO performance using tools such as SEMrush, Moz, Google Search Console, and other reporting tools used by Adventure Life.

- Implement SEO improvements and recommendations provided by Adventure Life’s SEO firm or other SEO reporting tools, such as technical audits, metadata fixes, duplicate content fixes, redirect and broken link fixes, etc. 

- Conduct rank, query, page, and keyword research and analysis for a variety of departments upon request for articles, itineraries, destination pages, and other pages.

- Identify and spearhead copy requests to fill content gaps to maximize SEO potential and search visibility across the website.

- Conduct ongoing destination or theme audits and optimization projects of existing website content to identify inaccuracies and areas for performance improvements.

- Execute and measure optimizations to assess SEO performance of changes. 

- Track top traffic page performance to assess SEO efforts.

- Track keyword database for all ‘owned’ keywords across Adventure Life’s top URLs.

- Manage all incoming website edit requests by staff and coordinate with copywriters, graphic designers, and relevant stakeholders to ensure requests are completed and published.

- Collaborate with Sales/Trip Planners and other internal stakeholders to ensure website content is accurate, relevant, and reflective of current travel expertise and offerings.



Required Skills and Experience:



- Computer literacy, including familiarity with Google Suite tools

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

- Basic knowledge of SEO/AIO principles and keyword research

- Critical thinking and analytics skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Independent work ethic and ability to meet communicated deadlines



Preferred Qualifications:



- A bachelor’s (or equivalent) degree in marketing, communications, or a related field

- 2+ years of relevant experience in digital marketing, content strategy, or SEO

- Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Search Console

- Familiarity with industry-standard software such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Moz, or Screaming Frog

- Travel industry knowledge or experience a plus



This is a full-time, 40 hours/week position scheduled by the Content Manager within Adventure Life business hours of 7AM-7PM Mountain Standard Time Monday through Friday (though schedule flexibility may be possible). This position is fully remote.



If interested, please submit the following: resume, cover letter, and portfolio or samples of related work. References are also encouraged.

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
Andrews Quality Creative Merch

Sales Support Specialist – Job Description & Application Workflow

About Andrews Quality Creative Merch

First established in 1989, Andrews Quality Creative Merch is a premier US-based promotional products and branded merchandise distributor. We are a progressive, 100% remote company where all tea
mbers work fully from their homes. Our operational ecosystem blends a seasoned domestic team of Account Executives with a dedicated, highly integrated support team based in the Philippines. We pride ourselves on a culture of efficiency, mutual success, and absolute operational excellence. We are looking for an elite, hyper-detailed Sales Support Specialist to join our growing Philippine support team.

Position Overview

The Sales Support Specialist owns all pre- and post-sale execution from initial presentation preparation through final delivery. This role is accountable for product sourcing, presentation generation, order entry, vendor coordination, proof workflow administration, shipment tracking, and order accuracy, but does not own final sales, creative development, or finance decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Pre-Sale Support: Conduct product research and source items based on detailed directions; build estimates, client presentations, and populate products into e-commerce storefronts/shops.

• Full Order Lifecycle: Manage the complete order workflow after sales handoff, including sourcing, pricing validation, quote preparation, and supplier communication.

• Order Maintenance: Set up and maintain basic and repeat orders in commonSKU and SAGE, including tagging, approval routing, and exception flagging.

• Logistics Coordination: Coordinate samples, product selection logistics, ship dates, garment/blank clothing discrepancies, and production timelines.

• Client Approvals: Administer the client approval workflow for artwork proofs and order releases, including supplier acknowledgment checks and tracking updates.

• Inventory & Tracking: Monitor inventory positions for ongoing replenishment programs; maintain meticulous CRM updates, order notes, in-hands dates, and tracking details.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Order accuracy rate & exception/rework i
.

• Presentation and estimate turnaround time.

• On-time delivery rate & proof/approval turnaround time.

• Shipment tracking updates sent on time.

• Clean CRM system administration and daily communication logs.

Success is measured by order accuracy, on-time delivery, rapid presentation turnaround, clean system administration, and smooth shipment communication.

Current Skills Required

• Proficient in basic commonSKU / SAGE order setup, data entry, and CRM maintenance.

• Competent at managing basic PO flow (checking acknowledgments against POs, proofing, tracking).

• Ability to source products and manage sample logistics with high attention to detail.

• Resilient 'firefighter' mindset capable of handling volume spikes, rush requests, and last-minute changes.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills for professional liaison between Client Reps, clients, and suppliers.

Infrastructure & Workspace Requirements

As a fully remote contractor, you must have a dedicated, quiet home office setup with high-speed, reliable internet service and a stable electricity connection with power redundancy solutions (such as a UPS or generator) to ensure continuous uptime during US business hours. You are required to provide your own functional laptop or PC capable of seamlessly running a remote portal Virtual PC. To efficiently navigate our multi-platform workflow, your workstation must be equipped with a second, full-size monitor.

What's In It For You?

• Hardware & Software Provided: No need to worry about costly subscriptions. Andrews will fully provision and provide all required business software and system access needed to perform your role.

• Work From Home with True Stability: Enjoy a long-term, stable independent contractor partnership within a professional, highly organized work-from-home setting.

• Clear Processes & Zero Guesswork: You will work within clean, established workflows alongside an expert team, backed by top-tier sales strategy and training frameworks.

• Time-Off and Culture: Benefit from a progressive, supportive team culture that respects your contribution and offers flexible time-off options to keep you performing at your best.

• Growth & Professional Development: We are deeply invested in our team's career paths, offering professional upskilling and a stable future as our US operations scale.

How to Apply

Please read carefully – failure to follow these steps will result in immediate disqualification:

To apply, please submit your resume directly to 
 with the following specific requirements:

1. Subject Line Format: Must be exactly in this format: "Sales Support Application – [Your Full Name] – [Your Total Years of Promo Industry Experience]" (e.g., Sales Support Application – Jane Doe – 4 Years)

2. Mandatory Acknowledgment Statement: In the body of your
, please copy and paste the following statement to acknowledge the role requirements:

"I explicitly acknowledge that this is a 100% remote Independent Contractor role. I am fully available and willing to work full-time during US Pacific Time Zone hours (7:30 AM – 4:00 PM PST / 10:30 PM – 7:00 AM Manila Time), and I am responsible for managing my own local taxes and benefits."

3. Core Screening Question: Below that statement, please provide a brief 2-3 sentence answer to this question:

• This position dynamically balances pre-sale work (sourcing and building presentations) with post-sale order coordination and tracking. Why does managing both sides of the order administrative lifecycle appeal to you?

*Applications submitted via the OnlineJobs.ph portal without a direct
, or
s missing the mandatory subject line format and signed acknowledgement statement, will be automatically filtered out.*
